function cutta_inventory_system:Player_SecurityCode()

local randomchars = {"q","w","e","r","t","y","u","i","o",

"p","a","s","d","f","g","h","j","k","l",

"z","x","c","v","b","n","m"}

local rnd1 = math.random(1,99)

local rnd2 = math.random(1,99)

local rnd3 = table.Random(randomchars)

local rnd4 = table.Random(randomchars)

local RandomId1 = tostring(rnd1..""..rnd2..""..rnd3..""..rnd4)

local RandomId2 = tostring(rnd2..""..rnd3..""..rnd4..""..rnd1)

local RandomId3 = tostring(rnd3..""..rnd4..""..rnd1..""..rnd2)

local RandomId4 = tostring(rnd4..""..rnd1..""..rnd2..""..rnd3)

local RandomId5 = tostring(rnd3..""..rnd1..""..rnd4..""..rnd2)

local RandomId6 = tostring(rnd1..""..rnd3..""..rnd2..""..rnd4)

local chance = math.random(1,6)

if chance == 1 then

return RandomId1

elseif chance == 2 then

return RandomId2

elseif chance == 3 then

return RandomId3

elseif chance == 4 then

return RandomId4

elseif chance == 5 then

return RandomId5

elseif chance == 6 then

return RandomId6

end

end

function cutta_inventory_system:Get_InventorySlotClass(slot)

if isstring(slot) then

return slot != "" and slot or nil

end

local class = slot.Class or slot.class

if not isstring(class) or class == "" then return nil end

return class

function cutta_inventory_system:Get_InventorySlotAmount(slot)

local class = cutta_inventory_system:Get_InventorySlotClass(slot)

if not class then return 0 end

function cutta_inventory_system:Count_InventoryOccupiedSlots(tbl)

local count = 0

for key, slot in pairs(tbl or {}) do

if not isnumber(key) then continue end

if cutta_inventory_system:InventorySlot_HasItem(slot) then

count = count + 1

end

end

return count

end

function cutta_inventory_system:Get_PlayerInvCapacity(ply)

local baseSlots = tonumber(cutta_inventory_system["Config"]["StartingInventorySize"] or 0) or 0

local maxSlots = tonumber(cutta_inventory_system["Config"]["MaxInventorySize"] or baseSlots) or baseSlots

if not IsValid(ply) or not ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]] then

return math.min(baseSlots, maxSlots)

end

local upgrades = ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]]["Upgrades"] or {}

local extraSlots = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(upgrades["InventoryUpg"] or 0) or 0), 0)

return math.min(maxSlots, baseSlots + extraSlots)

end

function cutta_inventory_system:Get_PlayerInvFull(ply)

if not IsValid(ply) then return true end

if not ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]] then return true end

local inv = ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]]["InventoryLayout"] or ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]]["Inventory"] or {}

return cutta_inventory_system:Count_InventoryOccupiedSlots(inv) >= cutta_inventory_system:Get_PlayerInvCapacity(ply)

end

local function CUTTINVSYS_IsTacRPWeapon(wep)

if not IsValid(wep) then return false end

if wep.ArcticTacRP then return true end

local base = wep.Base

if isstring(base) and string.find(string.lower(base), "tacrp", 1, true) then return true end

return false

end

local function CUTTINVSYS_IsTFAWeapon(wep)

if not IsValid(wep) then return false end

if wep.IsTFAWeapon or wep.TFAWeapon then return true end

local base = wep.Base

if isstring(base) and (string.find(string.lower(base), "tfa_", 1, true) or string.find(string.lower(base), "tfa", 1, true)) then return true end

return false

end

local function CUTTINVSYS_GetWepUpg(ply, wep, key)

if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return 0 end

if not IsValid(wep) then return 0 end

if not ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]] then return 0 end

local upg = ply[cutta_inventory_system["StringName"]]["Upgrades"]

if not upg or not upg["Guns"] then return 0 end

local wepUpg = upg["Guns"][wep:GetClass()]

if not wepUpg then return 0 end

return tonumber(wepUpg[key] or 0) or 0

end

-- TacRP integration:

-- TacRP computes weapon stats via SWEP:GetValue() and allows modification through hook.Run("TacRP_Stat_" .. stat).

-- We apply Cutta inventory upgrades there so stats update correctly without fighting TacRP's cache.

hook.Add("TacRP_Stat_Damage_Max", "CUTTINVSYS_TacRP_Upg_DamageMax", function(wep, data)

if not CUTTINVSYS_IsTacRPWeapon(wep) then return end

local owner = wep:GetOwner()

if not IsValid(owner) or not owner:IsPlayer() then return end

local pwr = CUTTINVSYS_GetWepUpg(owner, wep, "Damage")

if pwr <= 0 then return end

data.add = (data.add or 0) + pwr

end)

hook.Add("TacRP_Stat_Damage_Min", "CUTTINVSYS_TacRP_Upg_DamageMin", function(wep, data)

if not CUTTINVSYS_IsTacRPWeapon(wep) then return end

local owner = wep:GetOwner()

if not IsValid(owner) or not owner:IsPlayer() then return end

local pwr = CUTTINVSYS_GetWepUpg(owner, wep, "Damage")

if pwr <= 0 then return end

data.add = (data.add or 0) + pwr

end)

hook.Add("TacRP_Stat_ClipSize", "CUTTINVSYS_TacRP_Upg_ClipSize", function(wep, data)

if not CUTTINVSYS_IsTacRPWeapon(wep) then return end

local owner = wep:GetOwner()

if not IsValid(owner) or not owner:IsPlayer() then return end

local clip = CUTTINVSYS_GetWepUpg(owner, wep, "ClipSize")

if clip <= 0 then return end

data.add = (data.add or 0) + clip

end)

hook.Add("TacRP_Stat_RPM", "CUTTINVSYS_TacRP_Upg_RPM", function(wep, data)

if not CUTTINVSYS_IsTacRPWeapon(wep) then return end

local owner = wep:GetOwner()

if not IsValid(owner) or not owner:IsPlayer() then return end

local rpmUpg = CUTTINVSYS_GetWepUpg(owner, wep, "RPM")

if rpmUpg <= 0 then return end

data.add = (data.add or 0) + (rpmUpg * 5)

end)

hook.Add("TacRP_Stat_Spread", "CUTTINVSYS_TacRP_Upg_Accuracy", function(wep, data)

if not CUTTINVSYS_IsTacRPWeapon(wep) then return end

local owner = wep:GetOwner()

if not IsValid(owner) or not owner:IsPlayer() then return end

local acc = CUTTINVSYS_GetWepUpg(owner, wep, "Accuracy")

if acc <= 0 then return end

-- TacRP uses very small spread values (e.g., ~0.004), so use a smaller scaling than the legacy StatCache path.

data.add = (data.add or 0) - (acc * 0.0002)

end)

hook.Add("TacRP_Stat_RecoilKick", "CUTTINVSYS_TacRP_Upg_Recoil", function(wep, data)

if not CUTTINVSYS_IsTacRPWeapon(wep) then return end

local owner = wep:GetOwner()

if not IsValid(owner) or not owner:IsPlayer() then return end

local rec = CUTTINVSYS_GetWepUpg(owner, wep, "Recoil")

if rec <= 0 then return end

data.add = (data.add or 0) - (rec * 0.05)

end)

hook.Add("TacRP_Stat_ReloadTimeMult", "CUTTINVSYS_TacRP_Upg_Reload", function(wep, data)

if not CUTTINVSYS_IsTacRPWeapon(wep) then return end

local owner = wep:GetOwner()

if not IsValid(owner) or not owner:IsPlayer() then return end

local res = CUTTINVSYS_GetWepUpg(owner, wep, "ReloadSpeed")

if res <= 0 then return end

-- Lower ReloadTimeMult = faster reload.

local mult = math.Clamp(1 - (res * 0.05), 0.5, 1)

data.mul = (data.mul or 1) * mult

end)

-- TacRP integration:

-- TacRP computes weapon stats via SWEP:GetValue() and allows modification through hook.Run("TacRP_Stat_" .. stat).

-- We apply Cutta inventory upgrades there so stats update correctly without fighting TacRP's cache.

hook.Add("TacRP_Stat_Damage_Max", "CUTTINVSYS_TacRP_Upg_DamageMax", function(wep, data)

if not CUTTINVSYS_IsTacRPWeapon(wep) then return end

local owner = wep:GetOwner()

if not IsValid(owner) or not owner:IsPlayer() then return end

local pwr = CUTTINVSYS_GetWepUpg(owner, wep, "Damage")

if pwr <= 0 then return end

data.add = (data.add or 0) + pwr

end)

hook.Add("TacRP_Stat_Damage_Min", "CUTTINVSYS_TacRP_Upg_DamageMin", function(wep, data)

if not CUTTINVSYS_IsTacRPWeapon(wep) then return end

local owner = wep:GetOwner()

if not IsValid(owner) or not owner:IsPlayer() then return end

local pwr = CUTTINVSYS_GetWepUpg(owner, wep, "Damage")

if pwr <= 0 then return end

data.add = (data.add or 0) + pwr

end)

hook.Add("TacRP_Stat_ClipSize", "CUTTINVSYS_TacRP_Upg_ClipSize", function(wep, data)

if not CUTTINVSYS_IsTacRPWeapon(wep) then return end

local owner = wep:GetOwner()

if not IsValid(owner) or not owner:IsPlayer() then return end

local clip = CUTTINVSYS_GetWepUpg(owner, wep, "ClipSize")

if clip <= 0 then return end

data.add = (data.add or 0) + clip

end)

hook.Add("TacRP_Stat_RPM", "CUTTINVSYS_TacRP_Upg_RPM", function(wep, data)

if not CUTTINVSYS_IsTacRPWeapon(wep) then return end

local owner = wep:GetOwner()

if not IsValid(owner) or not owner:IsPlayer() then return end

local rpmUpg = CUTTINVSYS_GetWepUpg(owner, wep, "RPM")

if rpmUpg <= 0 then return end

data.add = (data.add or 0) + (rpmUpg * 5)

end)

hook.Add("TacRP_Stat_Spread", "CUTTINVSYS_TacRP_Upg_Accuracy", function(wep, data)

if not CUTTINVSYS_IsTacRPWeapon(wep) then return end

local owner = wep:GetOwner()

if not IsValid(owner) or not owner:IsPlayer() then return end

local acc = CUTTINVSYS_GetWepUpg(owner, wep, "Accuracy")

if acc <= 0 then return end

-- TacRP uses very small spread values (e.g., ~0.004), so use a smaller scaling than the legacy StatCache path.

data.add = (data.add or 0) - (acc * 0.0002)

end)

hook.Add("TacRP_Stat_RecoilKick", "CUTTINVSYS_TacRP_Upg_Recoil", function(wep, data)

if not CUTTINVSYS_IsTacRPWeapon(wep) then return end

local owner = wep:GetOwner()

if not IsValid(owner) or not owner:IsPlayer() then return end

local rec = CUTTINVSYS_GetWepUpg(owner, wep, "Recoil")

if rec <= 0 then return end

data.add = (data.add or 0) - (rec * 0.05)

end)

hook.Add("TacRP_Stat_ReloadTimeMult", "CUTTINVSYS_TacRP_Upg_Reload", function(wep, data)

if not CUTTINVSYS_IsTacRPWeapon(wep) then return end

local owner = wep:GetOwner()

if not IsValid(owner) or not owner:IsPlayer() then return end

local res = CUTTINVSYS_GetWepUpg(owner, wep, "ReloadSpeed")

if res <= 0 then return end

-- Lower ReloadTimeMult = faster reload.

local mult = math.Clamp(1 - (res * 0.05), 0.5, 1)

data.mul = (data.mul or 1) * mult

end)

function FS_ClientUI.GetFramePlayerData()
local frameNumber = FrameNumber()
local cachedFrameData = FS_ClientUI.FramePlayerData
if cachedFrameData and cachedFrameData.frameNumber == frameNumber then
return cachedFrameData
end

local localPlayer = LocalPlayer()
cachedFrameData = {
frameNumber = frameNumber,
player = localPlayer,
position = nil,
eyeYaw = 0,
focusEntity = nil
}

if IsValid(localPlayer) then
cachedFrameData.position = localPlayer:GetPos()
cachedFrameData.eyeYaw = localPlayer:EyeAngles().y
local eyeTrace = localPlayer:GetEyeTrace()
cachedFrameData.focusEntity = eyeTrace and eyeTrace.Entity or nil
end

FS_ClientUI.FramePlayerData = cachedFrameData
return cachedFrameData
end

function FS_ClientUI.GetBillboardAngle(eyeYaw)
return Angle(0, (eyeYaw or 0) - 90, 90)
end

function FS_ClientUI.GetEntityDrawContext(entity, maxDrawDistance, requireFocus)
if not IsValid(entity) then
return nil
end

local frameData = FS_ClientUI.GetFramePlayerData()
if not IsValid(frameData.player) or not frameData.position then
return nil
end

local drawDistance = maxDrawDistance or FS_DrawDistance
if drawDistance and drawDistance > 0 and frameData.position:DistToSqr(entity:GetPos()) > (drawDistance * drawDistance) then
return nil
end

if requireFocus and frameData.focusEntity ~= entity then
return nil
end

return frameData
end

local function getDecorColor(value)
if isfunction(value) then
return value()
end

return value or color_white
end

function FS_ClientUI.ApplyAlpha(colorValue, alpha)
if not colorValue then
return Color(255, 255, 255, alpha)
end

return Color(colorValue.r, colorValue.g, colorValue.b, math.Clamp(math.floor((colorValue.a or 255) * (alpha / 255)), 0, 255))
end

function FS_ClientUI.GetDistanceFadeAlpha(worldPosition, maxDrawDistance, fadeStartDistance)
local frameData = FS_ClientUI.GetFramePlayerData()
if not IsValid(frameData.player) or not frameData.position then
return 0
end

local maxDistance = maxDrawDistance or FS_DrawDistance
if not maxDistance or maxDistance <= 0 then
return 255
end

local distanceSqr = frameData.position:DistToSqr(worldPosition)
if distanceSqr >= (maxDistance * maxDistance) then
return 0
end

local fadeStart = fadeStartDistance or FS_ClientUI.FadeStartDistance or 250
if maxDistance <= fadeStart or distanceSqr <= (fadeStart * fadeStart) then
return 255
end

local distance = math.sqrt(distanceSqr)
local fadeFraction = 1 - ((distance - fadeStart) / (maxDistance - fadeStart))
return math.Clamp(math.floor(fadeFraction * 255), 0, 255)
end

function FS_ClientUI.ClearSeedHarvestDecor(entity)
if not IsValid(entity) or not entity.fsHarvestDecorModels then
return
end

for _, part in ipairs(entity.fsHarvestDecorModels) do
if IsValid(part) then
part:Remove()
end
end

entity.fsHarvestDecorModels = nil
end

function FS_ClientUI.DrawSeedHarvestDecor(entity, maxDrawDistance)
if not IsValid(entity) then
return false
end

if entity:GetDTInt(1) ~= 2 then
FS_ClientUI.ClearSeedHarvestDecor(entity)
return false
end

local frameData = FS_ClientUI.GetEntityDrawContext(entity, maxDrawDistance, false)
if not frameData then
return false
end

local meta = FS_ClientUI.GetSeedPatchMeta(entity)
local harvestDecor = meta and meta.harvestDecor
if not harvestDecor or #harvestDecor == 0 then
return false
end

if not entity.fsHarvestDecorModels or #entity.fsHarvestDecorModels ~= #harvestDecor then
FS_ClientUI.ClearSeedHarvestDecor(entity)
entity.fsHarvestDecorModels = {}
for index, decor in ipairs(harvestDecor) do
local part = ClientsideModel(decor.model, RENDERGROUP_BOTH)
if IsValid(part) then
part:SetNoDraw(true)
part:SetRenderMode(RENDERMODE_TRANSCOLOR)
entity.fsHarvestDecorModels[index] = part
end
end
end

for index, decor in ipairs(harvestDecor) do
local part = entity.fsHarvestDecorModels and entity.fsHarvestDecorModels[index]
if IsValid(part) then
local worldPos, worldAng = LocalToWorld(decor.pos or vector_origin, decor.ang or angle_zero, entity:GetPos(), entity:GetAngles())
part:SetPos(worldPos)
part:SetAngles(worldAng)
part:SetColor(getDecorColor(decor.color))
part:SetMaterial(decor.material or "")

local matrix = Matrix()
matrix:Scale(decor.scale or Vector(1, 1, 1))
part:EnableMatrix("RenderMultiply", matrix)
part:DrawModel()
end
end

return true
end

function FS_ClientUI.DrawSeedPatchInfo(entity, textPosition, seedTitle, plantTitle, titleColor, maxDrawDistance)
if not IsValid(entity) then
return
end

local localPlayer = LocalPlayer()
if not IsValid(localPlayer) then
return
end

local state = entity:GetDTInt(1)
local titleText = state == 0 and seedTitle or plantTitle
local bodyText = ""
local bodyColor = FS_ClientUI.NeutralColor
local panelWidth = 280
local panelHeight = 60

if state == 0 then
if entity:GetDTBool(3) then
bodyText = "Ready to plant"
bodyColor = FS_ClientUI.PositiveColor
else
bodyText = "Needs soil or a patch"
bodyColor = FS_ClientUI.WarningColor
end
panelWidth = 260
elseif state == 1 then
bodyText = "Growth: " .. string.ToMinutesSeconds(entity:GetDTInt(2))
bodyColor = FS_ClientUI.NeutralColor
panelWidth = 240
elseif state == 2 then
bodyText = "Ready for harvest"
bodyColor = FS_ClientUI.PositiveColor
panelWidth = 250
else
return
end

FS_ClientUI.DrawInfoPanel(titleText, bodyText, titleColor, bodyColor, textPosition, 0.11, panelWidth, panelHeight, maxDrawDistance)
end

function FS_ClientUI.DrawInfoPanel(titleText, bodyText, titleColor, bodyColor, textPosition, scale, panelWidth, panelHeight, maxDrawDistance)
local frameData = FS_ClientUI.GetFramePlayerData()
if not IsValid(frameData.player) then
return
end

local alpha = FS_ClientUI.GetDistanceFadeAlpha(textPosition, maxDrawDistance)
if alpha <= 0 then
return
end

local panelBackgroundColor = FS_ClientUI.ApplyAlpha(FS_ClientUI.PanelBackgroundColor, alpha)
local panelBorderColor = FS_ClientUI.ApplyAlpha(FS_ClientUI.PanelBorderColor, alpha)
local panelShadowColor = FS_ClientUI.ApplyAlpha(FS_ClientUI.PanelShadowColor, alpha)
local fadedTitleColor = FS_ClientUI.ApplyAlpha(titleColor, alpha)
local fadedBodyColor = FS_ClientUI.ApplyAlpha(bodyColor, alpha)

cam.IgnoreZ(true)
render.OverrideDepthEnable(true, false)
cam.Start3D2D(textPosition, FS_ClientUI.GetBillboardAngle(frameData.eyeYaw), scale or 0.11)
surface.SetDrawColor(panelBackgroundColor)
surface.DrawRect(-panelWidth * 0.5, -panelHeight * 0.5, panelWidth, panelHeight)
surface.SetDrawColor(panelBorderColor)
surface.DrawOutlinedRect(-panelWidth * 0.5, -panelHeight * 0.5, panelWidth, panelHeight)

draw.SimpleTextOutlined(titleText, "fsSeedPatchTitle", 0, -12, fadedTitleColor, TEXT_ALIGN_CENTER, TEXT_ALIGN_CENTER, 1, panelShadowColor)
draw.SimpleTextOutlined(bodyText, "fsSeedPatchBody", 0, 14, fadedBodyColor, TEXT_ALIGN_CENTER, TEXT_ALIGN_CENTER, 1, panelShadowColor)
cam.End3D2D()
render.OverrideDepthEnable(false, false)
cam.IgnoreZ(false)
end

function FS_ClientUI.GetSeedPatchMeta(entity)
if not IsValid(entity) then
return nil
end

return FS_ClientUI.SeedPatchMeta[entity:GetClass()]
end

function FS_ClientUI.GetSeedPatchTextPosition(entity)
if not IsValid(entity) then
return nil
end

local zOffset = entity:GetDTInt(1) >= 2 and 42 or 30
return entity:GetPos() + Vector(0, 0, zOffset)
end

function FS_ClientUI.DrawSeedPatchInfoForEntity(entity, textPosition, maxDrawDistance)
local meta = FS_ClientUI.GetSeedPatchMeta(entity)

return false
end

FS_ClientUI.DrawSeedPatchInfo(entity, textPosition or FS_ClientUI.GetSeedPatchTextPosition(entity), meta.seedTitle, meta.plantTitle, meta.color(), maxDrawDistance)
return true
end

function FS_ClientUI.DrawSeedEntityPanel(entity, maxDrawDistance)
if not IsValid(entity) then
return false
end

local parentEntity = entity:GetParent()
if IsValid(parentEntity) and parentEntity:GetClass() == "fs_dirt_patch" then
return false
end

local drawDistance = maxDrawDistance or FS_DrawDistance
if not drawDistance or drawDistance <= 0 then
return false
end

if not FS_ClientUI.GetEntityDrawContext(entity, drawDistance, false) then
return false
end

return FS_ClientUI.DrawSeedPatchInfoForEntity(entity, nil, drawDistance)
end

function FS_ClientUI.GetFramePlayerData()
local frameNumber = FrameNumber()
local cachedFrameData = FS_ClientUI.FramePlayerData
if cachedFrameData and cachedFrameData.frameNumber == frameNumber then
return cachedFrameData
end

local localPlayer = LocalPlayer()
cachedFrameData = {
frameNumber = frameNumber,
player = localPlayer,
position = nil,
eyeYaw = 0,
focusEntity = nil
}

if IsValid(localPlayer) then
cachedFrameData.position = localPlayer:GetPos()
cachedFrameData.eyeYaw = localPlayer:EyeAngles().y
local eyeTrace = localPlayer:GetEyeTrace()
cachedFrameData.focusEntity = eyeTrace and eyeTrace.Entity or nil
end

FS_ClientUI.FramePlayerData = cachedFrameData
return cachedFrameData
end

function FS_ClientUI.GetBillboardAngle(eyeYaw)
return Angle(0, (eyeYaw or 0) - 90, 90)
end

function FS_ClientUI.GetEntityDrawContext(entity, maxDrawDistance, requireFocus)
if not IsValid(entity) then
return nil
end

local frameData = FS_ClientUI.GetFramePlayerData()
if not IsValid(frameData.player) or not frameData.position then
return nil
end

local drawDistance = maxDrawDistance or FS_DrawDistance
if drawDistance and drawDistance > 0 and frameData.position:DistToSqr(entity:GetPos()) > (drawDistance * drawDistance) then
return nil
end

if requireFocus and frameData.focusEntity ~= entity then
return nil
end

return frameData
end

local function getDecorColor(value)
if isfunction(value) then
return value()
end

return value or color_white
end

function FS_ClientUI.ApplyAlpha(colorValue, alpha)
if not colorValue then
return Color(255, 255, 255, alpha)
end

return Color(colorValue.r, colorValue.g, colorValue.b, math.Clamp(math.floor((colorValue.a or 255) * (alpha / 255)), 0, 255))
end

function FS_ClientUI.GetDistanceFadeAlpha(worldPosition, maxDrawDistance, fadeStartDistance)
local frameData = FS_ClientUI.GetFramePlayerData()
if not IsValid(frameData.player) or not frameData.position then
return 0
end

local maxDistance = maxDrawDistance or FS_DrawDistance
if not maxDistance or maxDistance <= 0 then
return 255
end

local distanceSqr = frameData.position:DistToSqr(worldPosition)
if distanceSqr >= (maxDistance * maxDistance) then
return 0
end

local fadeStart = fadeStartDistance or FS_ClientUI.FadeStartDistance or 250
if maxDistance <= fadeStart or distanceSqr <= (fadeStart * fadeStart) then
return 255
end

local distance = math.sqrt(distanceSqr)
local fadeFraction = 1 - ((distance - fadeStart) / (maxDistance - fadeStart))
return math.Clamp(math.floor(fadeFraction * 255), 0, 255)
end

function FS_ClientUI.ClearSeedHarvestDecor(entity)
if not IsValid(entity) or not entity.fsHarvestDecorModels then
return
end

for _, part in ipairs(entity.fsHarvestDecorModels) do
if IsValid(part) then
part:Remove()
end
end

entity.fsHarvestDecorModels = nil
end

function FS_ClientUI.DrawSeedHarvestDecor(entity, maxDrawDistance)
if not IsValid(entity) then
return false
end

if entity:GetDTInt(1) ~= 2 then
FS_ClientUI.ClearSeedHarvestDecor(entity)
return false
end

local frameData = FS_ClientUI.GetEntityDrawContext(entity, maxDrawDistance, false)
if not frameData then
return false
end

local meta = FS_ClientUI.GetSeedPatchMeta(entity)
local harvestDecor = meta and meta.harvestDecor
if not harvestDecor or #harvestDecor == 0 then
return false
end

if not entity.fsHarvestDecorModels or #entity.fsHarvestDecorModels ~= #harvestDecor then
FS_ClientUI.ClearSeedHarvestDecor(entity)
entity.fsHarvestDecorModels = {}
for index, decor in ipairs(harvestDecor) do
local part = ClientsideModel(decor.model, RENDERGROUP_BOTH)
if IsValid(part) then
part:SetNoDraw(true)
part:SetRenderMode(RENDERMODE_TRANSCOLOR)
entity.fsHarvestDecorModels[index] = part
end
end
end

for index, decor in ipairs(harvestDecor) do
local part = entity.fsHarvestDecorModels and entity.fsHarvestDecorModels[index]
if IsValid(part) then
local worldPos, worldAng = LocalToWorld(decor.pos or vector_origin, decor.ang or angle_zero, entity:GetPos(), entity:GetAngles())
part:SetPos(worldPos)
part:SetAngles(worldAng)
part:SetColor(getDecorColor(decor.color))
part:SetMaterial(decor.material or "")

local matrix = Matrix()
matrix:Scale(decor.scale or Vector(1, 1, 1))
part:EnableMatrix("RenderMultiply", matrix)
part:DrawModel()
end
end

return true
end

function FS_ClientUI.DrawSeedPatchInfo(entity, textPosition, seedTitle, plantTitle, titleColor, maxDrawDistance)

return
end

local localPlayer = LocalPlayer()

return

local state = entity:GetDTInt(1)
local titleText = state == 0 and seedTitle or plantTitle
local bodyText = ""
local bodyColor = FS_ClientUI.NeutralColor
local panelWidth = 280
local panelHeight = 60

if state == 0 then
if entity:GetDTBool(3) then
bodyText = "Ready to plant"
bodyColor = FS_ClientUI.PositiveColor
else
bodyText = "Needs soil or a patch"
bodyColor = FS_ClientUI.WarningColor
end
panelWidth = 260
elseif state == 1 then
bodyText = "Growth: " .. string.ToMinutesSeconds(entity:GetDTInt(2))
bodyColor = FS_ClientUI.NeutralColor
panelWidth = 240
elseif state == 2 then
bodyText = "Ready for harvest"
bodyColor = FS_ClientUI.PositiveColor
panelWidth = 250
else
return
end

FS_ClientUI.DrawInfoPanel(titleText, bodyText, titleColor, bodyColor, textPosition, 0.11, panelWidth, panelHeight, maxDrawDistance)
end

function FS_ClientUI.DrawInfoPanel(titleText, bodyText, titleColor, bodyColor, textPosition, scale, panelWidth, panelHeight, maxDrawDistance)
local frameData = FS_ClientUI.GetFramePlayerData()
if not IsValid(frameData.player) then
return
end

local alpha = FS_ClientUI.GetDistanceFadeAlpha(textPosition, maxDrawDistance)
if alpha <= 0 then
return
end

local panelBackgroundColor = FS_ClientUI.ApplyAlpha(FS_ClientUI.PanelBackgroundColor, alpha)
local panelBorderColor = FS_ClientUI.ApplyAlpha(FS_ClientUI.PanelBorderColor, alpha)
local panelShadowColor = FS_ClientUI.ApplyAlpha(FS_ClientUI.PanelShadowColor, alpha)
local fadedTitleColor = FS_ClientUI.ApplyAlpha(titleColor, alpha)
local fadedBodyColor = FS_ClientUI.ApplyAlpha(bodyColor, alpha)

cam.IgnoreZ(true)
render.OverrideDepthEnable(true, false)
cam.Start3D2D(textPosition, FS_ClientUI.GetBillboardAngle(frameData.eyeYaw), scale or 0.11)
surface.SetDrawColor(panelBackgroundColor)
surface.DrawRect(-panelWidth * 0.5, -panelHeight * 0.5, panelWidth, panelHeight)
surface.SetDrawColor(panelBorderColor)
surface.DrawOutlinedRect(-panelWidth * 0.5, -panelHeight * 0.5, panelWidth, panelHeight)

draw.SimpleTextOutlined(titleText, "fsSeedPatchTitle", 0, -12, fadedTitleColor, TEXT_ALIGN_CENTER, TEXT_ALIGN_CENTER, 1, panelShadowColor)
draw.SimpleTextOutlined(bodyText, "fsSeedPatchBody", 0, 14, fadedBodyColor, TEXT_ALIGN_CENTER, TEXT_ALIGN_CENTER, 1, panelShadowColor)
cam.End3D2D()
render.OverrideDepthEnable(false, false)
cam.IgnoreZ(false)
end

function cutta_quest_system:Objective_MoveTo_Hud(objdata)
local point = objdata and (objdata.position or objdata["position"]) or nil

function cutta_quest_system:Objective_MoveToStart(ply,objdata) --Start Objective Time
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return end
if not objdata then return end
local position = objdata.position or objdata["position"]
if not position then return end

local distance = objdata.distance or objdata["distance"] or 250
if distance < 60 then distance = 60 end

local timeLimit = objdata.time or objdata["time"]
if timeLimit and timeLimit > 0 then
cutta_quest_system:Objective_TimerCreate_Failed(ply,timeLimit)

if timer.Exists(ply:Nick().."_"..cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."MoveToPos") then return end
timer.Create(ply:Nick().."_"..cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."MoveToPos",1,0,function()

timer.Remove(ply:Nick().."_"..cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."MoveToPos")
end
end
end

if not IsFirstTimePredicted() then return end

self:SetNextPrimaryFire(CurTime() + 0.2)

local owner = self:GetOwner()
if not IsValid(owner) then return end

owner:SetAnimation(PLAYER_ATTACK1)
self:EmitSound("Weapon_Pistol.Single")

if SERVER then

bullet.Src = owner:GetShootPos()
bullet.Dir = owner:GetAimVector()
bullet.Spread = Vector(0.02, 0.02, 0)
bullet.Damage = 12
bullet.Attacker = owner
owner:FireBullets(bullet)
self:TakePrimaryAmmo(1)
end
end

-- Deferred sound scanner: processes directories in small batches across ticks
local CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_TIMER = "CuttaQS_ResourceSoundScan"
local CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_INTERVAL = 0.1
local CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_DIRS_PER_TICK = 3
local CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_MAX_FILES = 2000

local function cuttaqs_resource_add_sounds_deferred(rootPath)
if not isstring(rootPath) then return end

local scanQueue = { rootPath }
local seen = {}
local addedFiles = 0

timer.Create(CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_TIMER, CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_INTERVAL, 0, function()
local dirsProcessed = 0

while dirsProcessed < CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_DIRS_PER_TICK and #scanQueue > 0 do
local currentPath = table.remove(scanQueue, 1)
if isstring(currentPath) and currentPath ~= "" and not seen[currentPath] then
seen[currentPath] = true
dirsProcessed = dirsProcessed + 1

local files, dirs = file.Find(currentPath .. "/*", "GAME")
files = files or {}
dirs = dirs or {}

if #dirs == 0 and #files > 0 then
for _, name in ipairs(files) do
if not cuttaqs_is_sound_file(name) and file.IsDir(currentPath .. "/" .. name, "GAME") then
table.insert(dirs, name)
end
end
end

for _, f in ipairs(files) do
if addedFiles >= CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_MAX_FILES then
print("[CuttaQS] Auto sound mount limit reached (" .. tostring(CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_MAX_FILES) .. ").")
timer.Remove(CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_TIMER)
return
end

if cuttaqs_is_sound_file(f) and not file.IsDir(currentPath .. "/" .. f, "GAME") then
resource.AddFile(currentPath .. "/" .. f)
addedFiles = addedFiles + 1
end
end

for _, d in ipairs(dirs) do
if isstring(d) and d ~= "" and d ~= "." and d ~= ".." and not string.StartWith(d, ".") then
table.insert(scanQueue, currentPath .. "/" .. d)
end
end
end
end

if #scanQueue <= 0 then
timer.Remove(CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_TIMER)
if addedFiles > 0 then
print("[CuttaQS] Auto-mounted " .. tostring(addedFiles) .. " sound files for download.")
end
end
end)
end

if not string.EndsWith(last, ellipsis) then

end
lines[maxLines] = last
end

return lines, lineH

local resetDay = questData.ResetDay or 0

resetHour = tonumber(resetHour) or 0
resetMin = tonumber(resetMin) or 0

local now = os.time()
local date = os.date("*t", now)

local checkDate = {
year = date.year,
month = date.month,
day = date.day,
hour = resetHour,
min = resetMin,
sec = 0
}

if resetMonth ~= 0 then checkDate.month = resetMonth end
if resetDay ~= 0 then checkDate.day = resetDay end

local resetTimestamp = os.time(checkDate)

local lastResetTimestamp = resetTimestamp
if resetTimestamp > now then
local prevDate = table.Copy(checkDate)
if resetMonth ~= 0 then
prevDate.year = prevDate.year - 1
elseif resetDay ~= 0 then
prevDate.month = prevDate.month - 1
if prevDate.month == 0 then
prevDate.month = 12
prevDate.year = prevDate.year - 1
end
else
prevDate.day = prevDate.day - 1
end
lastResetTimestamp = os.time(prevDate)
end

local lastComplete = ply_.CuttaQS_CompletionTimes and ply_.CuttaQS_CompletionTimes[questname] or 0

if lastComplete > lastResetTimestamp then
return false
end
elseif cutta_quest_system:Quests_IsColddown(questname) then
if cutta_quest_system:Quests_PlayerOnQuestColddown(ply_, questname) then
return false
end
end
else
if cutta_quest_system:Player_HasCompletedQuest(ply_, questname) then
return false
end
end

return true
end

local function CUTTAQS_IsGlobalFor(ent, ply)
if not IsValid(ent) or not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return false end

local key = CUTTAQS_GlobalIdKey()
local entGlobalId = ent:GetNWString(key, "")
if not entGlobalId or entGlobalId == "" then return false end

end

function ENT:CUTTAQS_ClearLock()
self.CUTTAQS_ActivePlayer = nil
self.CUTTAQS_LastInteract = nil
end

function ENT:CUTTAQS_LockValidFor(ply)
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return false end
if not IsValid(self.CUTTAQS_ActivePlayer) then return false end
return self.CUTTAQS_ActivePlayer == ply
end

function ENT:CUTTAQS_TickLock()
if not IsValid(self.CUTTAQS_ActivePlayer) then
self:CUTTAQS_ClearLock()
return
end

-- Release lock if solver walks away or goes AFK.
local now = CurTime()
local last = tonumber(self.CUTTAQS_LastInteract) or 0
if last > 0 and (now - last) > 20 then
self:CUTTAQS_ClearLock()
return
end

if self.CUTTAQS_ActivePlayer:GetPos():DistToSqr(self:GetPos()) > (175 * 175) then
self:CUTTAQS_ClearLock()
return
end
end

function ENT:CUTTAQS_TryAcquireLock(ply)
self:CUTTAQS_TickLock()

if self:CUTTAQS_LockValidFor(ply) then
self.CUTTAQS_LastInteract = CurTime()
return true
end

if IsValid(self.CUTTAQS_ActivePlayer) then
return false
end

-- New solver gets control; reset progress for a clean attempt.
self.CUTTAQS_ActivePlayer = ply
self.CUTTAQS_LastInteract = CurTime()
self.CUTTAQS_Progress = 0
return true
end

if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return false end
if self:GetIsSolved() then return false end
if ply:GetPos():DistToSqr(self:GetPos()) > (150 * 150) then return false end

local prefix = CUTTAQS_Prefix()
local owner = self:GetNWEntity(prefix .. "ObjectiveOwner")
local isGlobal = CUTTAQS_IsGlobalFor(self, ply)
if not isGlobal then
if IsValid(owner) and owner ~= ply then return false end
end

-- For global quests: anyone can open. For all puzzles: only one solver at a time.
if not isGlobal then
return self:CUTTAQS_TryAcquireLock(ply)
end

local advanceTimerId = CQS_CutSceneAdvanceTimerId(ply)

local function finishCutscene()
if not IsValid(ply) then return end
if not CQS_CutSceneSessionIsCurrent(ply, cutsceneSessionId, cutsceneObjectiveNumber) then return end

local shouldKeepCutsceneOn = false
local chainedCutsceneHold = 0.5
if cutta_quest_system:Player_InQuest(ply) then
local questName = cutta_quest_system:Player_QuestName(ply)
local questData = cutta_quest_system:Quests_GetQuestData(questName)
local objectives = questData and questData.Objectives or nil
if istable(objectives) then
local nextObjectiveNumber = (tonumber(cutta_quest_system:Player_Objective_Number(ply)) or 0) + 1
local nextObjectiveData = objectives[nextObjectiveNumber]
if istable(nextObjectiveData) then
local nextObjectiveName = tostring(nextObjectiveData.Obj_Name or "")
if nextObjectiveName == "cutscene" or nextObjectiveName == "video_cutscene" then
shouldKeepCutsceneOn = true
end
end
end
end

if not shouldKeepCutsceneOn then
cutta_quest_system:Quests_Player_SetCutscene_Toggle(ply,false)
end

local effectiveDelay = transitionDelay
if shouldKeepCutsceneOn then
effectiveDelay = math.max(effectiveDelay, chainedCutsceneHold)
end

if effectiveDelay <= 0 then
if not IsValid(ply) then return end
if not cutta_quest_system:Player_InQuest(ply) then return end
if not CQS_CutSceneSessionIsCurrent(ply, cutsceneSessionId, cutsceneObjectiveNumber) then return end
cutta_quest_system:Player_NextObjective(ply)
else
if timer.Exists(advanceTimerId) then
timer.Remove(advanceTimerId)
end

timer.Create(advanceTimerId, effectiveDelay, 1, function()
if not IsValid(ply) then return end
if not cutta_quest_system:Player_InQuest(ply) then return end
if not CQS_CutSceneSessionIsCurrent(ply, cutsceneSessionId, cutsceneObjectiveNumber) then return end
cutta_quest_system:Player_NextObjective(ply)
end)
end
end

if time <= 0 then
timer.Simple(0, finishCutscene)
else
timer.Create(timerId, time, 1, finishCutscene)
end
end

if not isvector(hitNormal) then return nil end

local ang = (-normal):Angle()
ang:RotateAroundAxis(ang:Right(), 90)

ang:RotateAroundAxis(normal, yawDiff)
end

return ang
end

function cutta_quest_system:Quests_IsValidQuestContainer(questContainer)

local function normalizeLanguageKey(lang)
if not isstring(lang) then return DefaultLanguage end

local lowered = string.lower(string.Trim(lang))
if lowered == "" then return DefaultLanguage end

local aliased = LanguageAliases[lowered]
if aliased then
if Languages[aliased] then return aliased end
return aliased
end

for short, _ in pairs(Languages) do
if string.lower(short) == lowered then
return short
end
end

local prefix = string.match(lowered, "^([a-z][a-z])[-_].+") or lowered
aliased = LanguageAliases[prefix]
if aliased then
if Languages[aliased] then return aliased end
return aliased
end

for short, _ in pairs(Languages) do
local shortLower = string.lower(short)
if shortLower == prefix or string.sub(shortLower, 1, 2) == prefix then
return short
end
end

return DefaultLanguage
end

)
local max = Vector(
math.max(p1.x, p2.x),
math.max(p1.y, p2.y),
math.max(p1.z, p2.z)
)
return min, max
end

local function CQS_ZoneBuildCache(zone)
if not istable(zone) then return nil end

local p = zone.pos or zone["pos"]
if isvector(p) then
local radius = tonumber(zone.radius or zone["radius"]) or CQS_GetDefaultJoinRadius()
if radius < 50 then radius = 50 end
return {
kind = "point2d",
pos = p,
x = p.x,
y = p.y,
z = p.z,
radius = radius,
radiusSqr = radius * radius,
}
end

local min, max = CQS_ZoneBounds(zone)
if not min or not max then return nil end

local center = (min + max) * 0.5
local radius = min:Distance(max) * 0.5
radius = math.max(radius, 80)

return {
kind = "box",
min = min,
max = max,
center = center,
radius = radius,
}
end

local function CQS_ZoneGatherDisplay(zone, zoneCache)
local cache = zoneCache or CQS_ZoneBuildCache(zone)
if not cache then return end

if cache.kind == "point2d" then
return cache.pos, cache.radius
end

if cache.kind == "box" then
return cache.center, cache.radius
end
end

local function CQS_SelectGlobalQuestGatherSound()
local cfg = cutta_quest_system["Configuration"] or {}
if cfg.EnableGlobalQuestStartMusic ~= true then return "" end

local forced = tostring(cfg.GlobalQuestStartMusic or "")
if forced ~= "" and forced ~= "Random" then
return forced
end

local sounds = cutta_quest_system["Sounds"] and cutta_quest_system["Sounds"]["GlobalQuestStart"] or nil
if not istable(sounds) or #sounds < 1 then return "" end

local candidates = {}
for _, s in ipairs(sounds) do
s = tostring(s or "")
if s ~= "" and s ~= "Random" then
table.insert(candidates, s)
end
end
if #candidates < 1 then return "" end
return table.Random(candidates)
end

function cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Gather_BroadcastStart(instance)

net.WriteString(tostring(instance.questname or ""))

function cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_IsPlayerInZone(ply, zone, zoneCache)
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return false end
local cache = zoneCache or CQS_ZoneBuildCache(zone)
if not cache then return false end

local pos = ply:GetPos()
if cache.kind == "point2d" then
-- treat this like a 2D circle at the point's Z (more forgiving than a full 3D sphere)
local dx = pos.x - cache.x
local dy = pos.y - cache.y
return (dx * dx + dy * dy) <= cache.radiusSqr
end

if cache.kind == "box" then
local min, max = cache.min, cache.max
return pos.x >= min.x and pos.x <= max.x
and pos.y >= min.y and pos.y <= max.y
and pos.z >= min.z and pos.z <= max.z
end

return false
end

local function CQS_CountValidParticipants(instance)
if not istable(instance) or not istable(instance.participants) then return 0 end
local count = 0
for ply, enabled in pairs(instance.participants) do
if enabled == true and IsValid(ply) and ply:IsPlayer() then
count = count + 1
end
end
return count
end

function cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_RemoveParticipant(globalId, ply)
local instance = cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_GetInstance(globalId)
if not instance or not istable(instance.participants) then return false end
if not ply then return false end

if instance.participants[ply] ~= true then
return false
end

instance.participants[ply] = nil

if CQS_CountValidParticipants(instance) < 1 then
cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Cleanup(globalId)
end

return true
end

function cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_FailPlayer(globalId, ply)
local instance = cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_GetInstance(globalId)
if not instance or instance.state ~= "running" then return false end
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return false end
if not cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_RemoveParticipant(globalId, ply) then return false end

-- Important: clear global id BEFORE resetting objectives, so Objective_RemoveEntities
-- doesn't remove shared global quest entities.
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars = ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars or {}
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars[cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalQuestId"] = nil

-- Clean up this player's objective state.
cutta_quest_system:Player_ResetQuestObjective(ply)
cutta_quest_system:Player_Objective_ResetNumber(ply)
cutta_quest_system:Objective_Soundcue_stopclientmusic(ply)
cutta_quest_system:Objective_Musiccue_stopclientmusic(ply)
cutta_quest_system:Player_EndQuest_Vars(ply, instance.questname)
cutta_quest_system:Player_PlayFailedQuestSound(ply)
cutta_quest_system:Player_ShowFailMessageText(ply)

return true
end

function cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_AdvanceOnce(globalId, objNumb)
local instance = cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_GetInstance(globalId)
if not instance or instance.state ~= "running" then return end

objNumb = tonumber(objNumb) or tonumber(instance.objNumb) or 0
if objNumb < 1 then return end

instance.advanceOnce = instance.advanceOnce or {}
if instance.advanceOnce[objNumb] then return end
instance.advanceOnce[objNumb] = true

-- Avoid re-entrancy; only advance if we're still on that objective.
timer.Simple(0, function()
local inst = cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_GetInstance(globalId)
if not inst or inst.state ~= "running" then return end
if tonumber(inst.objNumb) ~= objNumb then return end
-- Force because instant objectives (sound/music cues) can legitimately advance
-- within the normal anti-double-advance window.
cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Advance(globalId, true)
end)
end

function cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_IsPlayerInInstance(ply, globalId)

function cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_RequestStart(ply, questname)
local questData = cutta_quest_system:Quests_GetQuestData(questname)
if not questData or questData.GlobalQuest ~= true then
return false
end

-- Only allow ONE active global quest at a time (gathering or running)
local activeInst = CQS_GetAnyActiveGlobalInstance()
if activeInst then
local activeName = tostring(activeInst.questname or "")
if activeName == "" then activeName = "(unknown)" end
local stateTxt = tostring(activeInst.state or "active")
cutta_quest_system:PlayerChatBox(ply, string.format("A global quest is already %s: %s", stateTxt, activeName))
return false
end

if cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_GetInstanceIdForQuest(questname) then
cutta_quest_system:PlayerChatBox(ply, "A global instance of this quest is already active.")
return false
end

local zone = questData.GlobalQuestZone
local joinTime = tonumber(questData.GlobalQuestJoinTime) or 0
if joinTime < 1 then joinTime = 1 end

local zoneCache = CQS_ZoneBuildCache(zone)
if not zoneCache then
cutta_quest_system:PlayerChatBox(ply, "Global quest has no valid zone.")
return false
end

local globalId = CQS_MakeGlobalId(questname)

local instance = {
id = globalId,
questname = questname,
state = "gathering",
zone = zone,
zoneCache = zoneCache,
joinEndTime = CurTime() + joinTime,
gatherSound = CQS_SelectGlobalQuestGatherSound(),
participants = {},
objNumb = 0,
lastAdvance = 0,
spawnedForObj = {},
}

cutta_quest_system.GlobalQuestInstances[globalId] = instance
cutta_quest_system.GlobalQuestByQuestName[questname] = globalId

cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Gather_BroadcastStart(instance)

for _, p in ipairs(player.GetAll()) do
if IsValid(p) then
cutta_quest_system:PlayerChatBox(p, string.format("Global quest '%s' is starting soon. Go to the zone within %d seconds.", questname, math.floor(joinTime)))
end
end

timer.Create(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalGather_" .. globalId, 0.5, 0, function()
local inst = cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_GetInstance(globalId)
if not inst then
timer.Remove(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalGather_" .. globalId)
return
end

if inst.state ~= "gathering" then
timer.Remove(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalGather_" .. globalId)
return
end

-- If everyone is already in the zone, don't force them to wait out a long join timer.
-- Clamp remaining time down to 10 seconds (never increases the timer).
do
local players = player.GetHumans()
if #players > 0 and istable(inst.zone) and inst.joinEndTime then
local allInZone = true
for _, p in ipairs(players) do
if IsValid(p) and p:IsPlayer() then
if not cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_IsPlayerInZone(p, inst.zone, inst.zoneCache) then
allInZone = false
break
end
end
end
if allInZone then
local remaining = (inst.joinEndTime or 0) - CurTime()
if remaining > 10 then
inst.joinEndTime = CurTime() + 10
cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Gather_BroadcastStart(inst)
end
end
end
end

if CurTime() >= inst.joinEndTime then
timer.Remove(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalGather_" .. globalId)
cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Begin(globalId)
end
end)

return true
end

function cutta_quest_system:RandomGlobalQuestEvents_GetDelay()
local cfg = cutta_quest_system["Configuration"] or {}
local delay = tonumber(cfg["Random Global Quests Events Timer"]) or 600
if delay < 30 then delay = 30 end
if delay > 32760 then delay = 32760 end
return delay
end

function cutta_quest_system:RandomGlobalQuestEvents_IsEnabled()
local cfg = cutta_quest_system["Configuration"] or {}
return cfg["Enable Random Global Quests Events"] == true
end

function cutta_quest_system:RandomGlobalQuestEvents_TryRun()
if not cutta_quest_system then return false end
if not cutta_quest_system:RandomGlobalQuestEvents_IsEnabled() then return false end
if CQS_GetAnyActiveGlobalInstance() then return false end

local delay = cutta_quest_system:RandomGlobalQuestEvents_GetDelay()
local nextAt = tonumber(cutta_quest_system.RandomGlobalQuestEvents_NextAt)
if not nextAt then
-- default schedule: don't fire immediately just because the addon loaded
nextAt = CurTime() + delay
cutta_quest_system.RandomGlobalQuestEvents_NextAt = nextAt
return false
end

if CurTime() < nextAt then return false end
if #player.GetAll() < 1 then return false end

local questname = CQS_GetRandomGlobalQuestName()
-- advance the schedule regardless, so we don't spam checks if there are no global quests
cutta_quest_system.RandomGlobalQuestEvents_NextAt = CurTime() + delay
if not questname then return false end

return cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_RequestStartServer(questname) == true
end

function cutta_quest_system:RandomGlobalQuestEvents_RefreshTimer()
if timer.Exists(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "RandomGlobalQuestEvents") then
timer.Remove(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "RandomGlobalQuestEvents")
end

if not cutta_quest_system:RandomGlobalQuestEvents_IsEnabled() then
cutta_quest_system.RandomGlobalQuestEvents_NextAt = nil
return
end

-- Use a short repeating timer and a next-run timestamp.
-- This keeps the schedule consistent and allows a player-join trigger to fire immediately.
timer.Create(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "RandomGlobalQuestEvents", 5, 0, function()
if not cutta_quest_system then return end
cutta_quest_system:RandomGlobalQuestEvents_TryRun()
end)
end

cutta_quest_system:RandomGlobalQuestEvents_RefreshTimer()
if not cutta_quest_system:RandomGlobalQuestEvents_IsEnabled() then return end

-- First join after enabling: fire immediately once, then schedule the next run.

end

end)
end)

function cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Begin(globalId)
local instance = cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_GetInstance(globalId)
if not instance or instance.state ~= "gathering" then return end

instance.state = "running"

cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Gather_BroadcastEnd(instance.questname)

local joined = {}
for _, ply in ipairs(player.GetAll()) do
if IsValid(ply) and ply:IsPlayer() then
if not cutta_quest_system:Player_InQuest(ply) and cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_IsPlayerInZone(ply, instance.zone, instance.zoneCache) then
joined[ply] = true
end
end
end

if table.Count(joined) < 1 then
for _, p in ipairs(player.GetAll()) do
if IsValid(p) then
cutta_quest_system:PlayerChatBox(p, string.format("Global quest '%s' cancelled (no players in zone).", instance.questname))
end
end
cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Cleanup(globalId)
return
end

instance.participants = joined

for ply, _ in pairs(joined) do
if IsValid(ply) then
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars = ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars or {}
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["IsInQuest"] = true
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["InQuest"] = instance.questname
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["ObjNumb"] = 0
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["Objective"] = ""
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars[cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalQuestId"] = globalId
cutta_quest_system:PlayerVariableTransfer(ply)
cutta_quest_system:Player_ShowStartMessageText(ply)
end
end

cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Advance(globalId)
end

function cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Advance(globalId, force)
local instance = cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_GetInstance(globalId)
if not instance or instance.state ~= "running" then return end

local now = CurTime()
if not force then
if instance.lastAdvance and instance.lastAdvance > now - 0.25 then
return
end
end
instance.lastAdvance = now

local questData = cutta_quest_system:Quests_GetQuestData(instance.questname)
local objectives = questData and questData.Objectives or nil
if not istable(objectives) then
cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Fail(globalId)
return
end

instance.objNumb = (tonumber(instance.objNumb) or 0) + 1

if instance.objNumb > table.Count(objectives) then
cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Complete(globalId)
return
end

-- Reset first (avoid removing newly spawned entities)
for ply, _ in pairs(instance.participants) do
if IsValid(ply) then
cutta_quest_system:Player_ResetQuestObjective(ply)
cutta_quest_system:Player_Objective_SetNumber(ply, instance.objNumb)
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars = ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars or {}
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars[cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalQuestId"] = globalId
end
end

for ply, _ in pairs(instance.participants) do
if IsValid(ply) then
cutta_quest_system:Player_NextObjective_Ext(ply)
end
end
end

function cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Complete(globalId)
local instance = cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_GetInstance(globalId)
if not instance then return end
if instance.state == "completed" or instance.state == "completing" then return end
instance.state = "completing"

local participants = {}
for ply, _ in pairs(instance.participants or {}) do
if IsValid(ply) and ply:IsPlayer() then
table.insert(participants, ply)
end
end

for _, ply in ipairs(participants) do
if IsValid(ply) and ply:IsPlayer() then
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars = ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars or {}
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["IsInQuest"] = true
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["InQuest"] = instance.questname
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars[cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalQuestId"] = nil
cutta_quest_system:Player_QuestCompleteNamed(ply, instance.questname)
end
end

instance.state = "completed"

cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Cleanup(globalId)
end

function cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Fail(globalId)
local instance = cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_GetInstance(globalId)
if not instance then return end

-- Prevent recursion by clearing the global id before failing each player.
for ply, _ in pairs(instance.participants or {}) do
if IsValid(ply) then
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars = ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars or {}
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars[cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalQuestId"] = nil
cutta_quest_system:Player_QuestFailed(ply)
end
end

cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Cleanup(globalId)
end

function cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Cleanup(globalId)
local instance = cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_GetInstance(globalId)
if not instance then return end

-- ensure gather hud is cleared on clients
cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Gather_BroadcastEnd(instance.questname)

-- remove any remaining global entities
if cutta_quest_system.entitylist then
for _, ent in pairs(cutta_quest_system.entitylist) do
if IsValid(ent) and ent:GetNWString(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalQuestId", "") == globalId then
ent:Remove()
end
end
end

if timer.Exists(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalGather_" .. globalId) then
timer.Remove(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalGather_" .. globalId)
end

if cutta_quest_system.GlobalQuestByQuestName and instance.questname then
if cutta_quest_system.GlobalQuestByQuestName[instance.questname] == globalId then
cutta_quest_system.GlobalQuestByQuestName[instance.questname] = nil
end
end

cutta_quest_system.GlobalQuestInstances[globalId] = nil
end

function cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_OnObjectiveEntityRemoved(globalId, removedObjNumb)
local instance = cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_GetInstance(globalId)
if not instance or instance.state ~= "running" then return end

local currentObjNumb = tonumber(instance.objNumb) or 0
if currentObjNumb < 1 then return end

removedObjNumb = tonumber(removedObjNumb) or 0
if removedObjNumb > 0 and removedObjNumb ~= currentObjNumb then
return
end

-- If no required entities remain for this global quest, advance.
local anyLeft = false
if cutta_quest_system.entitylist then
for _, ent in pairs(cutta_quest_system.entitylist) do
if IsValid(ent)
and ent:GetNWString(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalQuestId", "") == globalId
and ent:GetNWBool(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "ObjectiveOwned", false)
and tonumber(ent:GetNWInt(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "ObjectiveObjNumb", 0)) == currentObjNumb then
anyLeft = true
break
end
end
end

if not anyLeft then
cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Advance(globalId)
end
end

-- Returns the global quest instance that the player is currently a participant of, or nil.
local function CQS_GetInstanceForPlayer(ply)
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return nil end
if not istable(cutta_quest_system.GlobalQuestInstances) then return nil end
for _, inst in pairs(cutta_quest_system.GlobalQuestInstances) do
if istable(inst) and inst.state == "running" and istable(inst.participants) then
if inst.participants[ply] == true then
return inst
end
end
end
return nil
end

-- Prevent players in the same global quest from dealing damage to each other.
hook.Add("EntityTakeDamage", cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalQuest_FriendlyFire", function(victim, dmginfo)
if not IsValid(victim) or not victim:IsPlayer() then return end
local attacker = dmginfo:GetAttacker()
if not IsValid(attacker) or not attacker:IsPlayer() then return end
if attacker == victim then return end

local victimInst = CQS_GetInstanceForPlayer(victim)
if not victimInst then return end
local attackerInst = CQS_GetInstanceForPlayer(attacker)
if not attackerInst then return end

if victimInst == attackerInst then
return true -- block the damage
end

local function cuttaqs_process_sound_job(job, bucket, maxDirsPerTick)
if not istable(job) or not istable(bucket) then return true end

job.queue = job.queue or {}

local processedDirs = 0

while processedDirs < maxDirsPerTick and #job.queue > 0 do
local dirNode = table.remove(job.queue, 1)
processedDirs = processedDirs + 1

if istable(dirNode) and isstring(dirNode.searchPath) and dirNode.searchPath ~= "" then
local files, dirs = file.Find(dirNode.searchPath .. "/*", "GAME")
files = files or {}
dirs = dirs or {}

if #dirs == 0 and #files > 0 then
for _, name in ipairs(files) do
if not cuttaqs_is_sound_file(name) and file.IsDir(dirNode.searchPath .. "/" .. name, "GAME") then
table.insert(dirs, name)
end
end
end

for _, f in ipairs(files) do
if cuttaqs_is_sound_file(f) and not file.IsDir(dirNode.searchPath .. "/" .. f, "GAME") then
local relPath = (dirNode.relativePath ~= "") and (dirNode.relativePath .. "/" .. f) or f
table.insert(bucket, relPath)
end
end

for _, d in ipairs(dirs) do
local nextSearch = dirNode.searchPath .. "/" .. d
local nextRelative = (dirNode.relativePath ~= "") and (dirNode.relativePath .. "/" .. d) or d
cuttaqs_enqueue_sound_dir(job, nextSearch, nextRelative)
end
end
end

return #job.queue <= 0
end

timer.Simple(CQS_SOUND_SCAN_INITIAL_DELAY, function()

timer.Create(CQS_SOUND_SCAN_TIMER, CQS_SOUND_SCAN_INTERVAL, 0, function()

end

local function CQS_NetOnCooldown(ply, key, cooldownSeconds)
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return true end
cooldownSeconds = tonumber(cooldownSeconds) or 0
if cooldownSeconds <= 0 then return false end

ply.CUTTAQS_NetCooldowns = ply.CUTTAQS_NetCooldowns or {}
local now = CurTime()
local nextAllowed = ply.CUTTAQS_NetCooldowns[key] or 0
if nextAllowed > now then return true end

ply.CUTTAQS_NetCooldowns[key] = now + cooldownSeconds
return false
end

local function CQS_ReadCompressedTable()
local size = net.ReadUInt(32)
if not isnumber(size) or size <= 0 then return nil end

local compressed = net.ReadData(size)
if not compressed then return nil end

local json = util.Decompress(compressed)
if not isstring(json) or json == "" then return nil end

return util.JSONToTable(json)
end

if maxBytes < 12000 then maxBytes = 12000 end

local json = util.TableToJSON(chunk)
local compressed = json and util.Compress(json) or nil
if not compressed then return false end

net.Start(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."settings_getquestlist_bulk")

net.WriteData(compressed, #compressed)
net.Send(ply)
return true
end

local chunk = {}
for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
table.insert(chunk, entry)

local testJson = util.TableToJSON(chunk)
local testCompressed = testJson and util.Compress(testJson) or nil
if testCompressed and #testCompressed > maxBytes and #chunk > 1 then
local lastEntry = table.remove(chunk)
sendChunk(chunk)
chunk = {}
table.insert(chunk, lastEntry)
end
end

sendChunk(chunk)
end

if not CQS_EnsureQuestPlayerState(completer) then return false end
if not cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_FeatureEnabled() then return false end

local sourceSteamID64 = tostring(completer.CuttaQS_QuestVars[cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "QuestGiverSource"] or "")
local sourceQuestName = tostring(completer.CuttaQS_QuestVars[cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "QuestGiverQuest"] or "")

if sourceQuestName ~= tostring(questName or "") then return false end

if not IsValid(giverPly) or not giverPly:IsPlayer() then return false end

data.Level = data.Level + 1
leveledUp = true
requiredXP = cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_RequiredXP(data.Level)
end

cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_ApplyNW(giverPly)
cutta_quest_system:PlayerSave(giverPly)
cutta_quest_system:PlayerChatBox(giverPly, string.format("Quest Giver XP +%d from %s finishing '%s'", xpAward, tostring(completer:Nick()), tostring(questName)))
if leveledUp then
cutta_quest_system:PlayerChatBox(giverPly, string.format("Quest Giver Level Up! You are now level %d", data.Level))
end

return true
end

local CQS_PLAYER_TRANSFER_CHUNK_MAX_BYTES = 18000

local function CQS_SendCompressedPayloadChunks(netName, recipient, compressedData, maxChunkSize)
if not IsValid(recipient) or not isstring(netName) or netName == "" then return end
if not isstring(compressedData) or #compressedData == 0 then return end

maxChunkSize = tonumber(maxChunkSize) or CQS_PLAYER_TRANSFER_CHUNK_MAX_BYTES
if maxChunkSize < 8000 then maxChunkSize = 8000 end

local totalSize = #compressedData
local totalChunks = math.ceil(totalSize / maxChunkSize)

for chunkIndex = 1, totalChunks do
local startIndex = (chunkIndex - 1) * maxChunkSize + 1
local endIndex = math.min(totalSize, startIndex + maxChunkSize - 1)
local part = string.sub(compressedData, startIndex, endIndex)
if isstring(part) and #part > 0 then
net.Start(netName)
net.WriteUInt(totalChunks, 16)
net.WriteUInt(chunkIndex, 16)
net.WriteUInt(totalSize, 32)
net.WriteUInt(#part, 16)
net.WriteData(part, #part)
net.Send(recipient)
end
end
end

function cutta_quest_system:Player_NextObjective(ply, force)
if not CQS_EnsureQuestPlayerState(ply) then return end
if cutta_quest_system:Player_InQuest(ply) then
local currentObjNumb = cutta_quest_system:Player_Objective_Number(ply)
local currentObjective = cutta_quest_system:Objective_Name(ply)
local isInstantObjective = (currentObjective == "soundcue" or currentObjective == "musiccue" or currentObjective == "stopmusiccue")
local bypassGuards = force and true or false

if currentObjNumb and currentObjNumb > 0 then
local lastAdvancedObj = ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars and tonumber(ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["LastAdvancedObjNumb"]) or nil
if (not bypassGuards) and lastAdvancedObj and lastAdvancedObj == currentObjNumb then
return
end

local setAt = ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars and tonumber(ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["ObjectiveSetAt"]) or 0
if (not bypassGuards) and (not isInstantObjective) and setAt > 0 and (CurTime() - setAt) < 0.2 then
return
end

ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars = ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars or {}
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["LastAdvancedObjNumb"] = currentObjNumb
cutta_quest_system:PlayerVariableTransfer(ply)
end

local globalIdKey = cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalQuestId"
local globalId = ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars and ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars[globalIdKey] or nil
if globalId and cutta_quest_system.GlobalQuest_AdvanceOnce then
cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_AdvanceOnce(globalId, currentObjNumb)
return
end
cutta_quest_system:Player_ResetQuestObjective(ply)
cutta_quest_system:Player_Objective_AddNumber(ply)
timer.Simple(0,function()
if ply:IsValid() then
cutta_quest_system:Player_NextObjective_Ext(ply)
end
end)

end
end

function cutta_quest_system:Player_NextObjective_Ext(ply)
if not CQS_EnsureQuestPlayerState(ply) then return end

local questName = cutta_quest_system:Player_QuestName(ply)
local questData = cutta_quest_system:Quests_GetQuestData(questName)
if not questData or not istable(questData.Objectives) then return end

local objectives = questData.Objectives
local objNumber = cutta_quest_system:Player_Objective_Number(ply)

if objNumber > table.Count(objectives) then
local globalIdKey = cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalQuestId"
local globalId = ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars and ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars[globalIdKey] or nil
if globalId and cutta_quest_system.GlobalQuest_Complete then
cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Complete(globalId)
return
end
cutta_quest_system:Player_QuestComplete(ply)
return
end

local objData = objectives[objNumber]
if not istable(objData) then return end
cutta_quest_system:Objective_SetObjective(ply, objData.Obj_Name, objData)
if objData.Obj_Text then
cutta_quest_system:PlayerChatBox(ply, objData.Obj_Text)
end
end

local function CQS_GenerateDuplicatedNPCID(baseID)
local cleanBase = string.lower(tostring(baseID or "dialoguenpc"))
if cleanBase == "" then
cleanBase = "dialoguenpc"
end

local copyBase = cleanBase .. "_copy"
if not cutta_quest_system["DialogueNPCs"][copyBase] then
return copyBase
end

local index = 2
while cutta_quest_system["DialogueNPCs"][copyBase .. tostring(index)] do
index = index + 1
end

return copyBase .. tostring(index)
end

entry:SetText(LocalPlayer().temp_QuestInfoTable[questname][key] or default)
entry:SetFont("cuttaqs_8bitfont_small")
entry.OnChange = function(self)
LocalPlayer().temp_QuestInfoTable[questname][key] = self:GetValue()
end
else
local entry = vgui.Create("DNumberWang", p)
entry:Dock(FILL)
entry:SetMin(0)
entry:SetMax(key == "ResetMonth" and 12 or 31)
entry:SetDecimals(0)
entry:SetValue(LocalPlayer().temp_QuestInfoTable[questname][key] or default)
entry.OnValueChanged = function(self, val)
LocalPlayer().temp_QuestInfoTable[questname][key] = tonumber(val)
end
end
end

local function CQS_DialogueSound_IsURL(soundPath)
if not isstring(soundPath) then return false end
soundPath = string.Trim(soundPath)
if soundPath == "" then return false end
return string.StartWith(soundPath, "http://") or string.StartWith(soundPath, "https://")
end

local function CQS_DialogueSound_NormalizeLocalPath(soundPath)
if not isstring(soundPath) then return nil end
soundPath = string.Trim(soundPath)
if soundPath == "" then return nil end
if string.StartWith(soundPath, "sound/") then
soundPath = string.sub(soundPath, 7)
end
return soundPath
end

function cutta_quest_system:Dialogue_Soundcue_Stop()
if not IsValid(LocalPlayer()) then return end

if timer.Exists("CUTTAQS_DialogueSoundTimer") then
timer.Remove("CUTTAQS_DialogueSoundTimer")
end

local channel = LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_DialogueSoundcue
if channel then
if channel.IsPlaying and channel:IsPlaying() and channel.Stop then
channel:Stop()
elseif channel.Stop then
channel:Stop()
end
end
LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_DialogueSoundcue = nil
end

function cutta_quest_system:Dialogue_Soundcue_Play(soundPath)
if not IsValid(LocalPlayer()) then return end
if not isstring(soundPath) then return end
soundPath = string.Trim(soundPath)
if soundPath == "" then return end

cutta_quest_system:Dialogue_Soundcue_Stop()

if CQS_DialogueSound_IsURL(soundPath) then
sound.PlayURL(tostring(soundPath), "", function(station)
if IsValid(station) then
station:SetPos(LocalPlayer():GetPos())
station:Play()
LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_DialogueSoundcue = station
end
end)
return
end

local normalized = CQS_DialogueSound_NormalizeLocalPath(soundPath)
if not normalized then return end

LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_DialogueSoundcue = CreateSound(LocalPlayer(), normalized)
if LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_DialogueSoundcue then
LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_DialogueSoundcue:Play()
end

local dur = SoundDuration(normalized)
if isnumber(dur) and dur > 0 then
timer.Create("CUTTAQS_DialogueSoundTimer", dur, 1, function()
if IsValid(LocalPlayer()) then
cutta_quest_system:Dialogue_Soundcue_Stop()
end
end)
end
end

if alpha <= 0.02 or not isActive then return 0 end

local pulse = (math.sin(CurTime() * 3.2) + 1) * 0.5
local width = math.min(308, ScrW() * 0.235)
local timeLeft = math.max(0, math.ceil(gg.endTime - CurTime()))

local contentY = CUTTAQS_DrawWrappedLines(titleLines, "cuttaqs_bankgothic", drawX + 18, y + 26, CUTTAQS_COLOR_TEXT, alpha, 2)
CUTTAQS_DrawTextLine("Window: " .. tostring(timeLeft) .. "s", "cuttaqs_8bitfont_small", drawX + 18, contentY + 2, CUTTAQS_COLOR_TEXT_SOFT, alpha)

if radius > 0 then

surface.SetMaterial(CUTTAQS_ICON_USER)

CUTTAQS_IsPlayerInGatherCircle = function(ply, center, radius)
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return false end
if not isvector(center) then return false end
radius = tonumber(radius) or 0
if radius <= 0 then return false end

local pos = ply:GetPos()
pos = Vector(pos.x, pos.y, center.z)
return pos:DistToSqr(center) <= (radius * radius)
end

function cutta_quest_system:Draw3DZone(pos, rad, clr, detail, thick)
local AlphaMask = CUTTAQS_COLOR_ALPHA_MASK
render.SetStencilEnable(true)
render.SetStencilWriteMask( 0xFF )
render.SetStencilTestMask( 0xFF )
render.SetStencilReferenceValue( 0 )
render.SetStencilCompareFunction( STENCIL_ALWAYS )
render.SetStencilPassOperation( STENCIL_KEEP )
render.SetStencilFailOperation( STENCIL_KEEP )
render.SetStencilZFailOperation( STENCIL_KEEP )
render.SetColorMaterial()
render.ClearStencil()
--All
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.SetStencilZFailOperation(STENCILOPERATION_REPLACE)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_ALWAYS)
render.DrawSphere(pos, -rad, detail, detail, AlphaMask)
--Under
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.SetStencilZFailOperation(STENCILOPERATION_DECR)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_ALWAYS)
render.DrawSphere(pos, rad, detail, detail, AlphaMask)
--Inner
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.SetStencilZFailOperation(STENCILOPERATION_INCR)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_ALWAYS)
render.DrawSphere(pos, -math.max(rad - thick, 0), detail, detail, AlphaMask)
render.SetStencilZFailOperation(STENCILOPERATION_DECR)
-- Overall
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_ALWAYS)
render.DrawSphere(pos, math.max(rad - thick, 0), detail, detail, AlphaMask)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_EQUAL)

cam.IgnoreZ(true)
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.DrawSphere(pos, -rad, detail, detail, clr)
cam.IgnoreZ(false)
render.SetStencilEnable(false)
end

if objData.Obj_Name ~= cutta_quest_system:Objective_Name(ply) then return end

local point = objData.position or objData["position"]
local distance = objData.distance or objData["distance"]

cutta_quest_system:Draw3DZone(point, distance, color_white, 30, 8)
end
end
end)

function cutta_quest_system:Draw3DZone(pos, rad, clr, detail, thick)
local AlphaMask = CUTTAQS_OBJHUD_ALPHA_MASK
render.SetStencilEnable(true)
render.SetStencilWriteMask( 0xFF )
render.SetStencilTestMask( 0xFF )
render.SetStencilReferenceValue( 0 )
render.SetStencilCompareFunction( STENCIL_ALWAYS )
render.SetStencilPassOperation( STENCIL_KEEP )
render.SetStencilFailOperation( STENCIL_KEEP )
render.SetStencilZFailOperation( STENCIL_KEEP )
render.SetColorMaterial()
render.ClearStencil()
--All
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.SetStencilZFailOperation(STENCILOPERATION_REPLACE)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_ALWAYS)
render.DrawSphere(pos, -rad, detail, detail, AlphaMask)
--Under
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.SetStencilZFailOperation(STENCILOPERATION_DECR)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_ALWAYS)
render.DrawSphere(pos, rad, detail, detail, AlphaMask)
--Inner
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.SetStencilZFailOperation(STENCILOPERATION_INCR)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_ALWAYS)
render.DrawSphere(pos, -math.max(rad - thick, 0), detail, detail, AlphaMask)
render.SetStencilZFailOperation(STENCILOPERATION_DECR)
-- Overall
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_ALWAYS)
render.DrawSphere(pos, math.max(rad - thick, 0), detail, detail, AlphaMask)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_EQUAL)

cam.IgnoreZ(true)
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.DrawSphere(pos, -rad, detail, detail, clr)
cam.IgnoreZ(false)
render.SetStencilEnable(false)
end

function cutta_quest_system:Menu_Objective_puzzle(frame, value, index, questname)

local function BuildPuzzleWallAngle(hitNormal, eyeYaw)
if not isvector(hitNormal) then return nil end

local normal = hitNormal:GetNormalized()
local ang = (-normal):Angle()
ang:RotateAroundAxis(ang:Right(), 90)
local yawDiff = math.AngleDifference(tonumber(eyeYaw) or 0, ang.y)
ang:RotateAroundAxis(normal, yawDiff)
return ang
end

local updatingAngleSliders = false

local function EnsurePreviewModel()
if IsValid(LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_Puzzle_previewModel) then return LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_Puzzle_previewModel end
LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_Puzzle_previewModel = ClientsideModel("models/props_lab/keypad.mdl", RENDERGROUP_OPAQUE)
if IsValid(LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_Puzzle_previewModel) then
LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_Puzzle_previewModel:SetNoDraw(false)
end
return LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_Puzzle_previewModel
end

local function RemovePreviewModel()
if IsValid(LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_Puzzle_previewModel) then
LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_Puzzle_previewModel:Remove()
end
LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_Puzzle_previewModel = nil
end

local function GetAngleTableFromData(data)
if not istable(data) and not isangle(data) then return nil end
local p = tonumber(data.p)
local y = tonumber(data.y)
local r = tonumber(data.r)
if p == nil or y == nil or r == nil then return nil end
return { p = p, y = y, r = r }
end

local function ResolveActiveAngleData(objData)
if not istable(objData) then return nil end
if objData["aim_wall"] then
return GetAngleTableFromData(objData["wall_ang"])
end
return GetAngleTableFromData(objData["angle"])
end

local function SetActiveAngleData(objData, p, y, r)
if not istable(objData) then return end
local angData = {
p = tonumber(p) or 0,
y = tonumber(y) or 0,
r = tonumber(r) or 0,
}

if objData["aim_wall"] then
objData["wall_ang"] = angData
else
objData["angle"] = angData
end

-- Deferred sound scanner: processes directories in small batches across ticks
local CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_TIMER = "CuttaQS_ResourceSoundScan"
local CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_INTERVAL = 0.1
local CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_DIRS_PER_TICK = 3
local CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_MAX_FILES = 2000

local function cuttaqs_resource_add_sounds_deferred(rootPath)
if not isstring(rootPath) then return end

local scanQueue = { rootPath }
local seen = {}
local addedFiles = 0

timer.Create(CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_TIMER, CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_INTERVAL, 0, function()
local dirsProcessed = 0

while dirsProcessed < CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_DIRS_PER_TICK and #scanQueue > 0 do
local currentPath = table.remove(scanQueue, 1)
if isstring(currentPath) and currentPath ~= "" and not seen[currentPath] then
seen[currentPath] = true
dirsProcessed = dirsProcessed + 1

local files, dirs = file.Find(currentPath .. "/*", "GAME")
files = files or {}
dirs = dirs or {}

if #dirs == 0 and #files > 0 then
for _, name in ipairs(files) do
if not cuttaqs_is_sound_file(name) and file.IsDir(currentPath .. "/" .. name, "GAME") then
table.insert(dirs, name)
end
end
end

for _, f in ipairs(files) do
if addedFiles >= CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_MAX_FILES then
print("[CuttaQS] Auto sound mount limit reached (" .. tostring(CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_MAX_FILES) .. ").")
timer.Remove(CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_TIMER)
return
end

if cuttaqs_is_sound_file(f) and not file.IsDir(currentPath .. "/" .. f, "GAME") then
resource.AddFile(currentPath .. "/" .. f)
addedFiles = addedFiles + 1
end
end

for _, d in ipairs(dirs) do
if isstring(d) and d ~= "" and d ~= "." and d ~= ".." and not string.StartWith(d, ".") then
table.insert(scanQueue, currentPath .. "/" .. d)
end
end
end
end

if #scanQueue <= 0 then
timer.Remove(CQS_RESOURCE_SCAN_TIMER)
if addedFiles > 0 then
print("[CuttaQS] Auto-mounted " .. tostring(addedFiles) .. " sound files for download.")
end
end
end)
end

local function TruncateText(text, font, maxWidth)
if not isstring(text) then text = tostring(text or "") end
if text == "" then return "" end
surface.SetFont(font)
local w = select(1, surface.GetTextSize(text))
if w <= maxWidth then return text end

local ellipsis = "..."
local low, high = 1, #text
while low < high do
local mid = math.floor((low + high) / 2)
local candidate = string.sub(text, 1, mid) .. ellipsis
local cw = select(1, surface.GetTextSize(candidate))
if cw <= maxWidth then
low = mid + 1
else
high = mid
end
end
local finalLen = math.max(1, low - 1)
return string.sub(text, 1, finalLen) .. ellipsis
end

local function WrapTextLines(text, font, maxWidth, maxLines)
if not isstring(text) then text = tostring(text or "") end
text = string.Trim(text)
if text == "" then return {}, 0 end
if not isnumber(maxWidth) or maxWidth <= 0 then return { text }, 0 end
if not isnumber(maxLines) or maxLines <= 0 then maxLines = 999 end

surface.SetFont(font)
local _, lineH = surface.GetTextSize("Ag")

local lines = {}
local current = ""

local function pushLine(s)
s = string.Trim(s or "")
if s ~= "" then
table.insert(lines, s)
end
end

local function fits(s)
local w = select(1, surface.GetTextSize(s))
return w <= maxWidth
end

local function chunkWord(word)
if fits(word) then
return { word }
end

local parts = {}
local remaining = word
while #remaining > 0 do
local low, high = 1, #remaining
while low < high do
local mid = math.ceil((low + high) / 2)
local candidate = string.sub(remaining, 1, mid)
if fits(candidate) then
low = mid
else
high = mid - 1
end
end
local take = math.max(1, low)
table.insert(parts, string.sub(remaining, 1, take))
remaining = string.sub(remaining, take + 1)
end
return parts
end

for word in string.gmatch(text, "%S+") do
local wordParts = chunkWord(word)
for _,part in ipairs(wordParts) do
local candidate = current ~= "" and (current .. " " .. part) or part
if fits(candidate) then
current = candidate
else
pushLine(current)
current = part
end
end
end
pushLine(current)

if #lines > maxLines then
lines = { unpack(lines, 1, maxLines) }
local ellipsis = "..."
local last = lines[maxLines] or ""
if not fits(last) then
last = TruncateText(last, font, maxWidth)
end
if not string.EndsWith(last, ellipsis) then
last = TruncateText(last .. ellipsis, font, maxWidth)
end
lines[maxLines] = last
end

return lines, lineH
end

local function CUTTAQS_Prefix()
if cutta_quest_system and cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] then
return cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"]
end
return "" -- fallback; should always exist in this addon
end

local function CUTTAQS_GlobalIdKey()
return CUTTAQS_Prefix() .. "GlobalQuestId"
end

local function CUTTAQS_IsGlobalFor(ent, ply)
if not IsValid(ent) or not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return false end

local key = CUTTAQS_GlobalIdKey()
local entGlobalId = ent:GetNWString(key, "")
if not entGlobalId or entGlobalId == "" then return false end

local plyGlobalId = ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars and ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars[key] or nil
return plyGlobalId == entGlobalId
end

function ENT:CUTTAQS_ClearLock()
self.CUTTAQS_ActivePlayer = nil
self.CUTTAQS_LastInteract = nil
end

function ENT:CUTTAQS_LockValidFor(ply)
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return false end
if not IsValid(self.CUTTAQS_ActivePlayer) then return false end
return self.CUTTAQS_ActivePlayer == ply
end

function ENT:CUTTAQS_TickLock()
if not IsValid(self.CUTTAQS_ActivePlayer) then
self:CUTTAQS_ClearLock()
return
end

-- Release lock if solver walks away or goes AFK.
local now = CurTime()
local last = tonumber(self.CUTTAQS_LastInteract) or 0
if last > 0 and (now - last) > 20 then
self:CUTTAQS_ClearLock()
return
end

if self.CUTTAQS_ActivePlayer:GetPos():DistToSqr(self:GetPos()) > (175 * 175) then
self:CUTTAQS_ClearLock()
return
end
end

function ENT:CUTTAQS_TryAcquireLock(ply)
self:CUTTAQS_TickLock()

if self:CUTTAQS_LockValidFor(ply) then
self.CUTTAQS_LastInteract = CurTime()
return true
end

if IsValid(self.CUTTAQS_ActivePlayer) then
return false
end

-- New solver gets control; reset progress for a clean attempt.
self.CUTTAQS_ActivePlayer = ply
self.CUTTAQS_LastInteract = CurTime()
self.CUTTAQS_Progress = 0
return true
end

function ENT:CUTTAQS_SetupPuzzle(dotCount)
dotCount = math.floor(tonumber(dotCount) or 4)
dotCount = math.Clamp(dotCount, 1, 8)

self:SetDotCount(dotCount)
self:SetPuzzleType("sequence")
self:SetIsSolved(false)

self.CUTTAQS_Sequence = {}
for i = 1, dotCount do
self.CUTTAQS_Sequence[i] = math.random(1, 8)
end
self.CUTTAQS_Progress = 0
self.CUTTAQS_Viewers = {}
self:CUTTAQS_ClearLock()
end

function ENT:CUTTAQS_CanOpen(ply)
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return false end
if self:GetIsSolved() then return false end
if ply:GetPos():DistToSqr(self:GetPos()) > (150 * 150) then return false end

local prefix = CUTTAQS_Prefix()
local owner = self:GetNWEntity(prefix .. "ObjectiveOwner")
local isGlobal = CUTTAQS_IsGlobalFor(self, ply)
if not isGlobal then
if IsValid(owner) and owner ~= ply then return false end
end

-- For global quests: anyone can open. For all puzzles: only one solver at a time.
if not isGlobal then
return self:CUTTAQS_TryAcquireLock(ply)
end

-- Global: allow open even if someone else is solving.
if not self.CUTTAQS_Viewers then self.CUTTAQS_Viewers = {} end
self.CUTTAQS_Viewers[ply] = true
return true
end

function ENT:CUTTAQS_CanPress(ply)
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return false end
if self:GetIsSolved() then return false end
if ply:GetPos():DistToSqr(self:GetPos()) > (150 * 150) then return false end

local prefix = CUTTAQS_Prefix()
local owner = self:GetNWEntity(prefix .. "ObjectiveOwner")
local isGlobal = CUTTAQS_IsGlobalFor(self, ply)
if not isGlobal then
if IsValid(owner) and owner ~= ply then return false end
end

if not self:CUTTAQS_LockValidFor(ply) then
-- Attempt to acquire if nobody currently has it.
return self:CUTTAQS_TryAcquireLock(ply)
end

self.CUTTAQS_LastInteract = CurTime()

return true
end

function ENT:CUTTAQS_SendState(ply)
if not IsValid(ply) then return end
local prefix = CUTTAQS_Prefix()
local progress = tonumber(self.CUTTAQS_Progress) or 0

net.Start(prefix .. "puzzle_state")
net.WriteEntity(self)
net.WriteUInt(self:GetDotCount() or 0, 4)
net.WriteUInt(progress, 4)
net.WriteBool(self:GetIsSolved() or false)
net.Send(ply)
end

function ENT:CUTTAQS_SendStateToViewers()
if not self.CUTTAQS_Viewers then return end
for ply, _ in pairs(self.CUTTAQS_Viewers) do
if IsValid(ply) and ply:IsPlayer() then
if ply:GetPos():DistToSqr(self:GetPos()) <= (300 * 300) then
self:CUTTAQS_SendState(ply)
else
self.CUTTAQS_Viewers[ply] = nil
end
else
self.CUTTAQS_Viewers[ply] = nil
end
end
end

function ENT:CUTTAQS_OpenFor(ply)
if not self:CUTTAQS_CanOpen(ply) then return end

if not self.CUTTAQS_Sequence or #self.CUTTAQS_Sequence <= 0 then
self:CUTTAQS_SetupPuzzle(self:GetDotCount() > 0 and self:GetDotCount() or 4)
end

local prefix = CUTTAQS_Prefix()
local progress = tonumber(self.CUTTAQS_Progress) or 0

-- Ensure viewer list is tracked for state broadcasts.
self.CUTTAQS_Viewers = self.CUTTAQS_Viewers or {}
self.CUTTAQS_Viewers[ply] = true

net.Start(prefix .. "puzzle_open")
net.WriteEntity(self)
net.WriteUInt(self:GetDotCount() or 0, 4)
net.WriteUInt(progress, 4)
net.Send(ply)
end

function ENT:CUTTAQS_HandlePress(ply, buttonIndex)
if not self:CUTTAQS_CanPress(ply) then return end

buttonIndex = math.floor(tonumber(buttonIndex) or 0)
if buttonIndex < 1 or buttonIndex > 8 then return end

self.CUTTAQS_Progress = tonumber(self.CUTTAQS_Progress) or 0
self.CUTTAQS_Sequence = self.CUTTAQS_Sequence or {}

local dotCount = self:GetDotCount() or #self.CUTTAQS_Sequence
dotCount = math.Clamp(dotCount, 1, 8)
if #self.CUTTAQS_Sequence ~= dotCount then
self:CUTTAQS_SetupPuzzle(dotCount)
end

local current = tonumber(self.CUTTAQS_Progress) or 0
local expected = self.CUTTAQS_Sequence[current + 1]

if buttonIndex == expected then
current = current + 1
else
current = 0
end

if current >= dotCount then
self:SetIsSolved(true)
self.CUTTAQS_Progress = dotCount
self:CUTTAQS_SendStateToViewers()

if cutta_quest_system and cutta_quest_system.Player_NextObjective then
timer.Simple(0, function()
if IsValid(ply) then
cutta_quest_system:Player_NextObjective(ply)
end
end)
end

timer.Simple(0, function()
if IsValid(self) then
self:Remove()
end
end)
return
end

self.CUTTAQS_Progress = current
self:CUTTAQS_SendStateToViewers()
end
