function npcVisuals:ResolveSequenceId(clientModel, sequenceName)
if not IsValid(clientModel) then return -1 end
if not isstring(sequenceName) or sequenceName == "" then return -1 end

local asNumber = tonumber(sequenceName)
if isnumber(asNumber) and asNumber >= 0 then
return math.floor(asNumber)
end

local direct = clientModel:LookupSequence(sequenceName)
if isnumber(direct) and direct >= 0 then
return direct
end

local targetLower = string.lower(sequenceName)
for _, seqName in ipairs(clientModel:GetSequenceList() or {}) do
local seqLower = string.lower(seqName)
if seqLower == targetLower then
return clientModel:LookupSequence(seqName)
end
end

for _, seqName in ipairs(clientModel:GetSequenceList() or {}) do
local seqLower = string.lower(seqName)
if string.find(seqLower, targetLower, 1, true) or string.find(targetLower, seqLower, 1, true) then
return clientModel:LookupSequence(seqName)
end
end

return -1
end

function npcVisuals:ApplySequence(ent, clientModel, sequenceName)
if not IsValid(ent) or not IsValid(clientModel) then return end

local targetSequence = string.Trim(tostring(sequenceName or ""))
local cacheKey = targetSequence ~= "" and targetSequence or "__idle__"
if ent.CUTTAQS_ClientSequenceName == cacheKey then return end

local sequenceId = self:ResolveSequenceId(clientModel, targetSequence)
if not (isnumber(sequenceId) and sequenceId >= 0) then
sequenceId = self:ResolveSequenceId(clientModel, "idle_all")
end

if not (isnumber(sequenceId) and sequenceId >= 0) then
for _, seqName in ipairs(clientModel:GetSequenceList() or {}) do
if string.find(string.lower(seqName), "idle", 1, true) then
sequenceId = clientModel:LookupSequence(seqName)
break
end
end
end

if isnumber(sequenceId) and sequenceId >= 0 then
clientModel:ResetSequence(sequenceId)
clientModel:ResetSequenceInfo()
clientModel:SetCycle(0)
clientModel:SetPlaybackRate(1)
end

ent.CUTTAQS_ClientSequenceName = cacheKey
end

function npcVisuals:UpdateUseTarget(ply)
if not IsValid(ply) then
self.LastUseTarget = nil
return nil
end

if not self.NextUseScanAt or self.NextUseScanAt <= CurTime() then
self.NextUseScanAt = CurTime() + 0.05

local bestEnt = nil
local bestScore = nil

for _, ent in ipairs(ents.FindInSphere(ply:GetPos(), self.UseDistance)) do
if IsValid(ent) then
local className = ent:GetClass()
if className == "cutta_quest_npc" or className == "cutta_quest_talktonpc" then
local distSqr = ply:GetPos():DistToSqr(ent:GetPos())
if distSqr <= self.UseDistanceSqr then
local toEnt = (ent:WorldSpaceCenter() - ply:EyePos())
if toEnt:LengthSqr() > 0 then
local facing = ply:GetAimVector():Dot(toEnt:GetNormalized())
if facing > 0.25 then
local score = (facing * 100000) - distSqr
if not bestScore or score > bestScore then
bestScore = score
bestEnt = ent
end
end
end
end
end
end
end

self.LastUseTarget = bestEnt
end

return self.LastUseTarget
end

function cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Dialogue_CL_Step(dialogText, options, singledialogue)
local ply = LocalPlayer()
if not IsValid(ply) then return end
local sess = ply.CUTTAQS_GlobalDialogueSession
if not istable(sess) or not sess.globalId or not sess.isStarter then return end

local payload = {
dialogText = dialogText,
options = options or {},
singledialogue = singledialogue and true or false,
}
local json = util.TableToJSON(payload)
local compressed = util.Compress(json)

net.Start(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."globalquest_dialogue_step")
net.WriteString(tostring(sess.globalId))
net.WriteUInt(#compressed, 32)
net.WriteData(compressed, #compressed)
net.SendToServer()
end

if CLIENT then
local CUTTAQS_COLLECT_ENT_CACHE = {}
local CUTTAQS_COLLECT_CACHE_NEXT = 0

local function CuttaQS_GetCollectObjectiveEntities(ply)
if CurTime() < CUTTAQS_COLLECT_CACHE_NEXT then

end

CUTTAQS_COLLECT_CACHE_NEXT = CurTime() + 0.2

end
end

end

function cutta_quest_system:Objective_EntPos_Hud(objdata)
local ply = LocalPlayer()
if cutta_quest_system:Player_InQuest(ply) then
local localPos = LocalPlayer():GetPos()
for _, v in ipairs(CuttaQS_GetCollectObjectiveEntities(ply)) do
if not IsValid(v) then continue end
local point = v:GetPos() + Vector(0,0,v:OBBMaxs().z) -- Gets the position of the entity, specifically the center
local data2D = point:ToScreen() -- Gets the position of the entity on your screen
cutta_quest_system:Hud_DrawArrowOverPoint(data2D.x,data2D.y,data2D.x,data2D.y)
if localPos:DistToSqr(v:GetPos()) > 50000 then continue end
cutta_quest_system:Hud_DrawTextOverPoint("Collect",data2D.x,data2D.y)
end
else
CUTTAQS_COLLECT_ENT_CACHE = {}
CUTTAQS_COLLECT_CACHE_NEXT = 0
end
end
end

end

end
end

end)

--Objective Entity Creation
function cutta_quest_system:Objective_CreateEntity(entclass,position,ply,isobj,health,model,isnpc,weapon,angle,datatable) --1,class 2,position, 3,player, 4,MustRemove/Kill 5,Health 6,entity model 7,is it npc 8,npc weapon 9,angle 10,datatable
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return end
if not isstring(entclass) or entclass == "" then return end
if not isvector(position) then return end
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars = istable(ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars) and ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars or {}
local ent
if isnpc then
for _numb,_info in pairs(list.Get( "NPC" )) do
if _numb == entclass then
ent = ents.Create(_info.Class)
if _info.Model then
if _info.Model then
ent:SetModel(tostring(_info.Model))
end
end
end
end
else
ent = ents.Create(entclass)
end
if not IsValid(ent) then
cutta_quest_system:PlayerChatBox(ply,tostring(entclass).." Doesnt Exist")
return
end
local normalizedModel = isstring(model) and string.Trim(model) or ""
local displayModelKey = cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "DisplayModel"
local displaySequenceKey = cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "DisplaySequence"
local normalizedSequence = istable(datatable) and isstring(datatable["seq"]) and string.Trim(datatable["seq"]) or ""
ent:SetNWEntity(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."ObjectiveOwner", ply) -- check objective entity ownerships
local ownerObjNumb = ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars and tonumber(ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["ObjNumb"]) or 0
ent:SetNWInt(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."ObjectiveObjNumb", ownerObjNumb)
local globalIdKey = cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalQuestId"
local globalId = ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars and ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars[globalIdKey] or nil
if globalId and globalId ~= "" then
ent:SetNWString(globalIdKey, globalId)
end

-- Cache ownership/objective metadata for robust remove handling when NW state is unavailable.
ent.CUTTAQS_ObjectiveOwner = ply
ent.CUTTAQS_ObjectiveObjNumb = ownerObjNumb
ent.CUTTAQS_GlobalQuestId = (isstring(globalId) and globalId ~= "") and globalId or nil

local wallMount = istable(datatable) and datatable.wall_mount and true or false
if wallMount then
ent:SetPos(position)
else
ent:SetPos(position+Vector(0,0,1))
end
if entclass == "cutta_quest_talktonpc" and normalizedModel ~= "" then
ent:SetModel(normalizedModel)
end

if entclass == "cutta_quest_talktonpc" then
ent:SetNWString(displayModelKey, normalizedModel)
ent:SetNWString(displaySequenceKey, normalizedSequence)
end

-- Set angle BEFORE spawning to avoid physics overriding it
if isangle(angle) then
ent:SetAngles(angle)
end

ent:Spawn()

if entclass == "cutta_quest_item" then
ent:SetCollisionGroup(COLLISION_GROUP_NONE)
ent:SetMoveType(MOVETYPE_VPHYSICS)
ent:SetPos(position+Vector(0,0,ent:OBBMaxs().z))
elseif entclass == "cutta_quest_puzzle" then
if wallMount then
if istable(datatable) and IsValid(datatable.parentEnt) and isvector(datatable.localPos) and isangle(datatable.localAng) then
ent:SetParent(datatable.parentEnt)
ent:SetLocalPos(datatable.localPos)
ent:SetLocalAngles(datatable.localAng)
end
else
-- Spawn slightly higher so the keypad model doesn't clip into the ground.
ent:SetPos(position + Vector(0, 0, 24))
end
elseif entclass == "cutta_quest_talktonpc" then
ent:SetPos(position+Vector(0,0,2))
if isangle(angle) then
ent:SetAngles(Angle(0,angle.yaw or angle.y or 0,0))
end

local advanceTimerId = CQS_CutSceneAdvanceTimerId(ply)

local function finishCutscene()
if not IsValid(ply) then return end
if not CQS_CutSceneSessionIsCurrent(ply, cutsceneSessionId, cutsceneObjectiveNumber) then return end

local shouldKeepCutsceneOn = false
local chainedCutsceneHold = 0.5
if cutta_quest_system:Player_InQuest(ply) then
local questName = cutta_quest_system:Player_QuestName(ply)
local questData = cutta_quest_system:Quests_GetQuestData(questName)
local objectives = questData and questData.Objectives or nil
if istable(objectives) then
local nextObjectiveNumber = (tonumber(cutta_quest_system:Player_Objective_Number(ply)) or 0) + 1
local nextObjectiveData = objectives[nextObjectiveNumber]
if istable(nextObjectiveData) then
local nextObjectiveName = tostring(nextObjectiveData.Obj_Name or "")
if nextObjectiveName == "cutscene" or nextObjectiveName == "video_cutscene" then
shouldKeepCutsceneOn = true
end
end
end
end

if not shouldKeepCutsceneOn then
cutta_quest_system:Quests_Player_SetCutscene_Toggle(ply,false)
end

local effectiveDelay = transitionDelay
if shouldKeepCutsceneOn then
effectiveDelay = math.max(effectiveDelay, chainedCutsceneHold)
end

if effectiveDelay <= 0 then
if not IsValid(ply) then return end
if not cutta_quest_system:Player_InQuest(ply) then return end
if not CQS_CutSceneSessionIsCurrent(ply, cutsceneSessionId, cutsceneObjectiveNumber) then return end
cutta_quest_system:Player_NextObjective(ply)
else
if timer.Exists(advanceTimerId) then
timer.Remove(advanceTimerId)
end

timer.Create(advanceTimerId, effectiveDelay, 1, function()
if not IsValid(ply) then return end
if not cutta_quest_system:Player_InQuest(ply) then return end
if not CQS_CutSceneSessionIsCurrent(ply, cutsceneSessionId, cutsceneObjectiveNumber) then return end
cutta_quest_system:Player_NextObjective(ply)
end)
end
end

if time <= 0 then
timer.Simple(0, finishCutscene)
else
timer.Create(timerId, time, 1, finishCutscene)
end
end

local function CUTTAQS_Puzzle_WallAngleFromNormal(hitNormal, eyeYaw)
if not isvector(hitNormal) then return nil end

local normal = hitNormal:GetNormalized()
local ang = (-normal):Angle()
ang:RotateAroundAxis(ang:Right(), 90)

if eyeYaw ~= nil then
local yawDiff = math.AngleDifference(tonumber(eyeYaw) or 0, ang.y)
ang:RotateAroundAxis(normal, yawDiff)
end

return ang
end

hasKnownQuestData = true
end

if questData.Reward ~= nil then
if not istable(questData.Reward) then return false end
hasKnownQuestData = true
end

if questData.Required ~= nil then
if not istable(questData.Required) then return false end
hasKnownQuestData = true
end

if questData.Restrictions ~= nil then
if not istable(questData.Restrictions) then return false end
hasKnownQuestData = true
end

if questData.Repeatable ~= nil then
hasKnownQuestData = true
end

if questData.IsColddown ~= nil then
hasKnownQuestData = true
end

if questData.ColddownTime ~= nil then
hasKnownQuestData = true
end

end

function cutta_quest_system:Quests_IsValidQuestContainer(questContainer)
if not istable(questContainer) then return false end

local keyCount = 0
for questName, questData in pairs(questContainer) do
keyCount = keyCount + 1
if keyCount > 1 then
return false
end

if not (isstring(questName) or isnumber(questName)) then
return false
end

local trimmedQuestName = string.Trim(tostring(questName))
if trimmedQuestName == "" then
return false
end

if not cutta_quest_system:Quests_IsValidQuestData(questData) then
return false
end
end

return keyCount == 1
end

local function normalizeLanguageKey(lang)
if not isstring(lang) then return DefaultLanguage end

local lowered = string.lower(string.Trim(lang))
if lowered == "" then return DefaultLanguage end

local aliased = LanguageAliases[lowered]
if aliased then
if Languages[aliased] then return aliased end
return aliased
end

for short, _ in pairs(Languages) do
if string.lower(short) == lowered then
return short
end
end

local prefix = string.match(lowered, "^([a-z][a-z])[-_].+") or lowered
aliased = LanguageAliases[prefix]
if aliased then
if Languages[aliased] then return aliased end
return aliased
end

for short, _ in pairs(Languages) do
local shortLower = string.lower(short)
if shortLower == prefix or string.sub(shortLower, 1, 2) == prefix then
return short
end
end

return DefaultLanguage
end

return "@" .. id .. "@"
end

local function translateFormatForLanguage(language, id, ...)
local formatString = translateGetForLanguage(language, id)
if select("#", ...) < 1 then return formatString end
if not isstring(formatString) or formatString == "" then return "" end
if not string.find(formatString, "%%[-+# 0]*[%d%.%*]*[cdeEfgGiouXxqs]") then return formatString end

for index = 1, select("#", ...) do
local value = tostring(select(index, ...))
output = string.gsub(output, "%%[-+# 0]*[%d%.%*]*[cdeEfgGiouXxqs]", value, 1)
end
output = string.gsub(output, "\1", "%%")
return output
end

function cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_IsPlayerInZone(ply, zone, zoneCache)
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return false end
local cache = zoneCache or CQS_ZoneBuildCache(zone)
if not cache then return false end

local pos = ply:GetPos()
if cache.kind == "point2d" then
-- treat this like a 2D circle at the point's Z (more forgiving than a full 3D sphere)
local dx = pos.x - cache.x
local dy = pos.y - cache.y
return (dx * dx + dy * dy) <= cache.radiusSqr
end

if cache.kind == "box" then
local min, max = cache.min, cache.max
return pos.x >= min.x and pos.x <= max.x
and pos.y >= min.y and pos.y <= max.y
and pos.z >= min.z and pos.z <= max.z
end

return false
end

local function CQS_SendCompressedChunk(netName, recipient, payloadTable)
if not istable(payloadTable) then return end
if not isstring(netName) or netName == "" then return end

local json = util.TableToJSON(payloadTable)
if not json then return end

local compressed = util.Compress(json)
if not compressed then return end

net.Start(netName)
net.WriteUInt(#compressed, 32)
net.WriteData(compressed, #compressed)

if IsValid(recipient) then
net.Send(recipient)
else
net.Broadcast()
end
end

return
end

local timerName = string.format("%sChunkQueue_%s_%s", tostring(cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] or "CQS"), tostring(recipient:EntIndex()), string.gsub(tostring(netName or ""), "[^%w]", "_"))
if timer.Exists(timerName) then
timer.Remove(timerName)
end

local index = 1
local function finishQueue()
if timer.Exists(timerName) then
timer.Remove(timerName)
end
if isfunction(onDone) then
onDone()
end
end

local function sendNextChunk()
if not IsValid(recipient) then
if timer.Exists(timerName) then
timer.Remove(timerName)
end
return
end

local compressedData = chunks[index]
if isstring(compressedData) and #compressedData > 0 then
CQS_SendPreCompressedChunk(netName, recipient, compressedData)
end

index = index + 1
if index > #chunks then
finishQueue()
end
end

sendNextChunk()
if index <= #chunks then
timer.Create(timerName, CQS_PLAYER_SYNC_CHUNK_INTERVAL, 0, sendNextChunk)
end
end

local function CQS_AppendChunkedEntry(chunks, chunk, chunkBytes, entry, entryJson, maxBytes)
local jsonSize = isstring(entryJson) and #entryJson or 0
if jsonSize <= 0 then return chunk, chunkBytes end

local projectedBytes = chunkBytes + jsonSize
if #chunk > 0 then
projectedBytes = projectedBytes + 1
end

if projectedBytes > maxBytes and #chunk > 0 then
chunks[#chunks + 1] = chunk
chunk = {}
chunkBytes = 0
end

chunk[#chunk + 1] = entry
if #chunk > 1 then
chunkBytes = chunkBytes + 1
end
chunkBytes = chunkBytes + jsonSize

return chunk, chunkBytes
end

local function CQS_SendCompressedChunks(netName, recipient, entries, maxBytes, onDone)
if not istable(entries) or #entries <= 0 then
if isfunction(onDone) then
onDone()
end
return
end

maxBytes = tonumber(maxBytes) or CQS_TRANSFER_CHUNK_MAX_BYTES
if maxBytes < 12000 then
maxBytes = 12000
end

local chunks = {}
local chunk = {}
local chunkBytes = 0

for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
local entryJson = util.TableToJSON(entry)
if entryJson then
chunk, chunkBytes = CQS_AppendChunkedEntry(chunks, chunk, chunkBytes, entry, entryJson, maxBytes)
end
end

if #chunk > 0 then
chunks[#chunks + 1] = chunk
end

local function sendQueuedChunk(index)
if recipient ~= nil and not IsValid(recipient) then
if isfunction(onDone) then
onDone()
end
return
end

local nextChunk = chunks[index]
if istable(nextChunk) and #nextChunk > 0 then
CQS_SendCompressedChunk(netName, recipient, nextChunk)
end

if index < #chunks then
timer.Simple(0, function()
sendQueuedChunk(index + 1)
end)
elseif isfunction(onDone) then
onDone()
end
end

sendQueuedChunk(1)
end

-- Pre-build compressed chunks for a set of entries and return cached byte-string array
local function CQS_BuildCompressedChunks(entries, maxBytes)
if not istable(entries) or #entries <= 0 then return {} end

maxBytes = tonumber(maxBytes) or CQS_TRANSFER_CHUNK_MAX_BYTES
if maxBytes < 12000 then maxBytes = 12000 end

local chunks = {}
local chunk = {}
local chunkBytes = 0

local function flushChunk()
if #chunk <= 0 then return end
local json = util.TableToJSON(chunk)
local compressed = json and util.Compress(json) or nil
if compressed then
chunks[#chunks + 1] = compressed
end
chunk = {}
chunkBytes = 0
end

for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
local entryJson = util.TableToJSON(entry)
if entryJson then
local projectedBytes = chunkBytes + #entryJson
if #chunk > 0 then
projectedBytes = projectedBytes + 1
end

if projectedBytes > maxBytes and #chunk > 0 then
flushChunk()
end

table.insert(chunk, entry)
if #chunk > 1 then
chunkBytes = chunkBytes + 1
end
chunkBytes = chunkBytes + #entryJson
end
end

flushChunk()
return chunks
end

local function cuttaqs_is_sound_file(filename)
if not isstring(filename) then return false end
if string.StartWith(filename, ".") then return false end
local ext = string.lower(string.GetExtensionFromFilename(filename) or "")
return ext == "wav" or ext == "mp3" or ext == "ogg"
end

local CQS_SOUND_SCAN_TIMER = "CuttaQuestSystem_SoundScanQueue"
local CQS_SOUND_SCAN_INITIAL_DELAY = 8
local CQS_SOUND_SCAN_INTERVAL = 0.5
local CQS_SOUND_SCAN_DIRS_PER_TICK = 1

local function cuttaqs_prepare_sound_bucket(soundStore, key, includeRandom)
if not istable(soundStore) then return end

if not istable(soundStore[key]) then
soundStore[key] = {}
else
table.Empty(soundStore[key])
end

if includeRandom then
table.insert(soundStore[key], "Random")
end
end

local function cuttaqs_enqueue_sound_dir(job, searchPath, relativePath)
if not istable(job) then return end
if not isstring(searchPath) or searchPath == "" then return end
job.queue = job.queue or {}
job.queue[#job.queue + 1] = {
searchPath = searchPath,
relativePath = relativePath or ""
}
end

local function cuttaqs_process_sound_job(job, bucket, maxDirsPerTick)
if not istable(job) or not istable(bucket) then return true end

job.queue = job.queue or {}

local processedDirs = 0

while processedDirs < maxDirsPerTick and #job.queue > 0 do
local dirNode = table.remove(job.queue, 1)
processedDirs = processedDirs + 1

if istable(dirNode) and isstring(dirNode.searchPath) and dirNode.searchPath ~= "" then
local files, dirs = file.Find(dirNode.searchPath .. "/*", "GAME")
files = files or {}
dirs = dirs or {}

if #dirs == 0 and #files > 0 then
for _, name in ipairs(files) do
if not cuttaqs_is_sound_file(name) and file.IsDir(dirNode.searchPath .. "/" .. name, "GAME") then
table.insert(dirs, name)
end
end
end

for _, f in ipairs(files) do
if cuttaqs_is_sound_file(f) and not file.IsDir(dirNode.searchPath .. "/" .. f, "GAME") then
local relPath = (dirNode.relativePath ~= "") and (dirNode.relativePath .. "/" .. f) or f
table.insert(bucket, relPath)
end
end

for _, d in ipairs(dirs) do
local nextSearch = dirNode.searchPath .. "/" .. d
local nextRelative = (dirNode.relativePath ~= "") and (dirNode.relativePath .. "/" .. d) or d
cuttaqs_enqueue_sound_dir(job, nextSearch, nextRelative)
end
end
end

return #job.queue <= 0
end

local function cuttaqs_queue_sound_scan(cqs)
if not istable(cqs) then return end

cqs["Sounds"] = cqs["Sounds"] or {}

local scanJobs = {
{ key = "Complete", searchPath = "sound/cutta_quest_system/complete", includeRandom = true, queue = {}, done = false },
{ key = "Start", searchPath = "sound/cutta_quest_system/start", includeRandom = true, queue = {}, done = false },
{ key = "Fail", searchPath = "sound/cutta_quest_system/fail", includeRandom = true, queue = {}, done = false },
{ key = "Music", searchPath = "sound/cutta_quest_system/music", includeRandom = false, queue = {}, done = false },
{ key = "SFX", searchPath = "sound/cutta_quest_system/sfx", includeRandom = false, queue = {}, done = false },
{ key = "GlobalQuestStart", searchPath = "sound/cutta_quest_system/globalquests", includeRandom = true, queue = {}, done = false }
}

for _, job in ipairs(scanJobs) do
cuttaqs_prepare_sound_bucket(cqs["Sounds"], job.key, job.includeRandom)
cuttaqs_enqueue_sound_dir(job, job.searchPath, "")
end

if timer.Exists(CQS_SOUND_SCAN_TIMER) then
timer.Remove(CQS_SOUND_SCAN_TIMER)
end

timer.Simple(CQS_SOUND_SCAN_INITIAL_DELAY, function()
if not istable(cutta_quest_system) then return end

local activeJobIndex = 1
timer.Create(CQS_SOUND_SCAN_TIMER, CQS_SOUND_SCAN_INTERVAL, 0, function()
if not istable(cutta_quest_system) then
timer.Remove(CQS_SOUND_SCAN_TIMER)
return
end

local unfinishedCount = 0
for _, jobState in ipairs(scanJobs) do
if not jobState.done then
unfinishedCount = unfinishedCount + 1
end
end

if unfinishedCount <= 0 then
timer.Remove(CQS_SOUND_SCAN_TIMER)

for _, ply in ipairs(player.GetAll()) do
cqs:Quests_SoundTransfer_ply(ply)
end
print("[CuttaQS] Sound scan queue complete.")
return
end

local selectedJob = nil
local selectedIndex = activeJobIndex
for offset = 0, #scanJobs - 1 do
local idx = ((activeJobIndex - 1 + offset) % #scanJobs) + 1
if not scanJobs[idx].done then
selectedJob = scanJobs[idx]
selectedIndex = idx
break
end
end

if not selectedJob then
return
end

local bucket = cqs["Sounds"][selectedJob.key]
if not istable(bucket) then
bucket = {}
cqs["Sounds"][selectedJob.key] = bucket
if selectedJob.includeRandom then
table.insert(bucket, "Random")
end
end

selectedJob.done = cuttaqs_process_sound_job(selectedJob, bucket, CQS_SOUND_SCAN_DIRS_PER_TICK)
if selectedJob.done then
table.sort(bucket, function(a, b)
if a == "Random" then return true end
if b == "Random" then return false end
return tostring(a) < tostring(b)
end)
end

activeJobIndex = (selectedIndex % #scanJobs) + 1
end)
end)
end

local function CQS_NetOnCooldown(ply, key, cooldownSeconds)
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return true end
cooldownSeconds = tonumber(cooldownSeconds) or 0
if cooldownSeconds <= 0 then return false end

ply.CUTTAQS_NetCooldowns = ply.CUTTAQS_NetCooldowns or {}
local now = CurTime()
local nextAllowed = ply.CUTTAQS_NetCooldowns[key] or 0
if nextAllowed > now then return true end

ply.CUTTAQS_NetCooldowns[key] = now + cooldownSeconds
return false
end

function cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_AwardQuestXP(completer, questName)
if not CQS_EnsureQuestPlayerState(completer) then return false end
if not cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_FeatureEnabled() then return false end

local sourceSteamID64 = tostring(completer.CuttaQS_QuestVars[cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "QuestGiverSource"] or "")
local sourceQuestName = tostring(completer.CuttaQS_QuestVars[cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "QuestGiverQuest"] or "")
if sourceSteamID64 == "" or sourceQuestName == "" then return false end
if sourceQuestName ~= tostring(questName or "") then return false end

local giverPly = cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_FindPlayerBySteamID64(sourceSteamID64)
if not IsValid(giverPly) or not giverPly:IsPlayer() then return false end

local data = cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_EnsureData(giverPly)
if not data then return false end

local xpAward = cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_XPPerQuest()
data.XP = data.XP + xpAward
data.TotalXP = data.TotalXP + xpAward

local leveledUp = false
local requiredXP = cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_RequiredXP(data.Level)
while data.XP >= requiredXP do
data.XP = data.XP - requiredXP
data.Level = data.Level + 1
leveledUp = true
requiredXP = cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_RequiredXP(data.Level)
end

cutta_quest_system:QuestGiver_ApplyNW(giverPly)
cutta_quest_system:PlayerSave(giverPly)
cutta_quest_system:PlayerChatBox(giverPly, string.format("Quest Giver XP +%d from %s finishing '%s'", xpAward, tostring(completer:Nick()), tostring(questName)))
if leveledUp then
cutta_quest_system:PlayerChatBox(giverPly, string.format("Quest Giver Level Up! You are now level %d", data.Level))
end

return true
end

local CQS_PLAYER_TRANSFER_CHUNK_MAX_BYTES = 18000

local function CQS_SendCompressedPayloadChunks(netName, recipient, compressedData, maxChunkSize)
if not IsValid(recipient) or not isstring(netName) or netName == "" then return end
if not isstring(compressedData) or #compressedData == 0 then return end

maxChunkSize = tonumber(maxChunkSize) or CQS_PLAYER_TRANSFER_CHUNK_MAX_BYTES
if maxChunkSize < 8000 then maxChunkSize = 8000 end

local totalSize = #compressedData
local totalChunks = math.ceil(totalSize / maxChunkSize)

for chunkIndex = 1, totalChunks do
local startIndex = (chunkIndex - 1) * maxChunkSize + 1
local endIndex = math.min(totalSize, startIndex + maxChunkSize - 1)
local part = string.sub(compressedData, startIndex, endIndex)
if isstring(part) and #part > 0 then
net.Start(netName)
net.WriteUInt(totalChunks, 16)
net.WriteUInt(chunkIndex, 16)
net.WriteUInt(totalSize, 32)
net.WriteUInt(#part, 16)
net.WriteData(part, #part)
net.Send(recipient)
end
end
end

if globalId and cutta_quest_system.GlobalQuest_Fail then
cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Fail(globalId)
return
end
cutta_quest_system:Player_PlayFailedQuestSound(ply)
cutta_quest_system:Player_EndQuest(ply)
--cutta_quest_system:PlayerChatBox(ply,"Quest Failed")

function cutta_quest_system:Player_NextObjective(ply, force)
if not CQS_EnsureQuestPlayerState(ply) then return end
if cutta_quest_system:Player_InQuest(ply) then
local currentObjNumb = cutta_quest_system:Player_Objective_Number(ply)
local currentObjective = cutta_quest_system:Objective_Name(ply)
local isInstantObjective = (currentObjective == "soundcue" or currentObjective == "musiccue" or currentObjective == "stopmusiccue")
local bypassGuards = force and true or false

if currentObjNumb and currentObjNumb > 0 then
local lastAdvancedObj = ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars and tonumber(ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["LastAdvancedObjNumb"]) or nil
if (not bypassGuards) and lastAdvancedObj and lastAdvancedObj == currentObjNumb then
return
end

local setAt = ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars and tonumber(ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["ObjectiveSetAt"]) or 0
if (not bypassGuards) and (not isInstantObjective) and setAt > 0 and (CurTime() - setAt) < 0.2 then
return
end

ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars = ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars or {}
ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars["LastAdvancedObjNumb"] = currentObjNumb
cutta_quest_system:PlayerVariableTransfer(ply)
end

local globalIdKey = cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalQuestId"
local globalId = ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars and ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars[globalIdKey] or nil
if globalId and cutta_quest_system.GlobalQuest_AdvanceOnce then
cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_AdvanceOnce(globalId, currentObjNumb)
return
end
cutta_quest_system:Player_ResetQuestObjective(ply)
cutta_quest_system:Player_Objective_AddNumber(ply)
timer.Simple(0,function()
if ply:IsValid() then
cutta_quest_system:Player_NextObjective_Ext(ply)
end
end)

end
end

function cutta_quest_system:Player_NextObjective_Ext(ply)
if not CQS_EnsureQuestPlayerState(ply) then return end

local questName = cutta_quest_system:Player_QuestName(ply)
local questData = cutta_quest_system:Quests_GetQuestData(questName)
if not questData or not istable(questData.Objectives) then return end

local objectives = questData.Objectives
local objNumber = cutta_quest_system:Player_Objective_Number(ply)

if objNumber > table.Count(objectives) then
local globalIdKey = cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"] .. "GlobalQuestId"
local globalId = ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars and ply.CuttaQS_QuestVars[globalIdKey] or nil
if globalId and cutta_quest_system.GlobalQuest_Complete then
cutta_quest_system:GlobalQuest_Complete(globalId)
return
end
cutta_quest_system:Player_QuestComplete(ply)
return
end

local objData = objectives[objNumber]
if not istable(objData) then return end
cutta_quest_system:Objective_SetObjective(ply, objData.Obj_Name, objData)
if objData.Obj_Text then
cutta_quest_system:PlayerChatBox(ply, objData.Obj_Text)
end
end

local function CQS_GenerateDuplicatedNPCID(baseID)
local cleanBase = string.lower(tostring(baseID or "dialoguenpc"))
if cleanBase == "" then
cleanBase = "dialoguenpc"
end

local copyBase = cleanBase .. "_copy"
if not cutta_quest_system["DialogueNPCs"][copyBase] then
return copyBase
end

local index = 2
while cutta_quest_system["DialogueNPCs"][copyBase .. tostring(index)] do
index = index + 1
end

return copyBase .. tostring(index)
end

local function CQS_DialogueSound_IsURL(soundPath)
if not isstring(soundPath) then return false end
soundPath = string.Trim(soundPath)
if soundPath == "" then return false end
return string.StartWith(soundPath, "http://") or string.StartWith(soundPath, "https://")
end

local function CQS_DialogueSound_NormalizeLocalPath(soundPath)
if not isstring(soundPath) then return nil end
soundPath = string.Trim(soundPath)
if soundPath == "" then return nil end
if string.StartWith(soundPath, "sound/") then
soundPath = string.sub(soundPath, 7)
end
return soundPath
end

function cutta_quest_system:Dialogue_Soundcue_Stop()
if not IsValid(LocalPlayer()) then return end

if timer.Exists("CUTTAQS_DialogueSoundTimer") then
timer.Remove("CUTTAQS_DialogueSoundTimer")
end

local channel = LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_DialogueSoundcue
if channel then
if channel.IsPlaying and channel:IsPlaying() and channel.Stop then
channel:Stop()
elseif channel.Stop then
channel:Stop()
end
end
LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_DialogueSoundcue = nil
end

function cutta_quest_system:Dialogue_Soundcue_Play(soundPath)
if not IsValid(LocalPlayer()) then return end
if not isstring(soundPath) then return end
soundPath = string.Trim(soundPath)
if soundPath == "" then return end

cutta_quest_system:Dialogue_Soundcue_Stop()

if CQS_DialogueSound_IsURL(soundPath) then
sound.PlayURL(tostring(soundPath), "", function(station)
if IsValid(station) then
station:SetPos(LocalPlayer():GetPos())
station:Play()
LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_DialogueSoundcue = station
end
end)
return
end

local normalized = CQS_DialogueSound_NormalizeLocalPath(soundPath)
if not normalized then return end

LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_DialogueSoundcue = CreateSound(LocalPlayer(), normalized)
if LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_DialogueSoundcue then
LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_DialogueSoundcue:Play()
end

local dur = SoundDuration(normalized)
if isnumber(dur) and dur > 0 then
timer.Create("CUTTAQS_DialogueSoundTimer", dur, 1, function()
if IsValid(LocalPlayer()) then
cutta_quest_system:Dialogue_Soundcue_Stop()
end
end)
end
end

CUTTAQS_IsPlayerInGatherCircle = function(ply, center, radius)
if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:IsPlayer() then return false end
if not isvector(center) then return false end
radius = tonumber(radius) or 0
if radius <= 0 then return false end

local pos = ply:GetPos()
pos = Vector(pos.x, pos.y, center.z)
return pos:DistToSqr(center) <= (radius * radius)
end

function cutta_quest_system:Draw3DZone(pos, rad, clr, detail, thick)
local AlphaMask = CUTTAQS_COLOR_ALPHA_MASK
render.SetStencilEnable(true)
render.SetStencilWriteMask( 0xFF )
render.SetStencilTestMask( 0xFF )
render.SetStencilReferenceValue( 0 )
render.SetStencilCompareFunction( STENCIL_ALWAYS )
render.SetStencilPassOperation( STENCIL_KEEP )
render.SetStencilFailOperation( STENCIL_KEEP )
render.SetStencilZFailOperation( STENCIL_KEEP )
render.SetColorMaterial()
render.ClearStencil()
--All
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.SetStencilZFailOperation(STENCILOPERATION_REPLACE)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_ALWAYS)
render.DrawSphere(pos, -rad, detail, detail, AlphaMask)
--Under
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.SetStencilZFailOperation(STENCILOPERATION_DECR)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_ALWAYS)
render.DrawSphere(pos, rad, detail, detail, AlphaMask)
--Inner
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.SetStencilZFailOperation(STENCILOPERATION_INCR)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_ALWAYS)
render.DrawSphere(pos, -math.max(rad - thick, 0), detail, detail, AlphaMask)
render.SetStencilZFailOperation(STENCILOPERATION_DECR)
-- Overall
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_ALWAYS)
render.DrawSphere(pos, math.max(rad - thick, 0), detail, detail, AlphaMask)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_EQUAL)

cam.IgnoreZ(true)
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.DrawSphere(pos, -rad, detail, detail, clr)
cam.IgnoreZ(false)
render.SetStencilEnable(false)
end

local CUTTAQS_OBJHUD_ALPHA_MASK = Color(0, 0, 0, 0)

hook.Add("PostDrawTranslucentRenderables", cutta_quest_system["CQS_STRINGNAME"].."PositionRing", function()
local ply = LocalPlayer()
if cutta_quest_system:Player_InQuest(ply) then
local questname = cutta_quest_system:Player_QuestName(ply)
local questData = cutta_quest_system.Quests_GetQuestData and cutta_quest_system:Quests_GetQuestData(questname) or nil
local objectives = questData and questData.Objectives or nil
if not objectives then return end

local objNumber = tonumber(cutta_quest_system:Player_Objective_Number(ply))
local objData = objNumber and (objectives[objNumber] or objectives[tostring(objNumber)]) or nil
if not objData then return end
if objData.Obj_Name == "soundcue" or objData.Obj_Name == "musiccue" or objData.Obj_Name == "cutscene" then return end
if objData.Obj_Name ~= cutta_quest_system:Objective_Name(ply) then return end

local point = objData.position or objData["position"]
local distance = objData.distance or objData["distance"]
if point and distance then
cutta_quest_system:Draw3DZone(point, distance, color_white, 30, 8)
end
end
end)

function cutta_quest_system:Draw3DZone(pos, rad, clr, detail, thick)
local AlphaMask = CUTTAQS_OBJHUD_ALPHA_MASK
render.SetStencilEnable(true)
render.SetStencilWriteMask( 0xFF )
render.SetStencilTestMask( 0xFF )
render.SetStencilReferenceValue( 0 )
render.SetStencilCompareFunction( STENCIL_ALWAYS )
render.SetStencilPassOperation( STENCIL_KEEP )
render.SetStencilFailOperation( STENCIL_KEEP )
render.SetStencilZFailOperation( STENCIL_KEEP )
render.SetColorMaterial()
render.ClearStencil()
--All
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.SetStencilZFailOperation(STENCILOPERATION_REPLACE)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_ALWAYS)
render.DrawSphere(pos, -rad, detail, detail, AlphaMask)
--Under
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.SetStencilZFailOperation(STENCILOPERATION_DECR)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_ALWAYS)
render.DrawSphere(pos, rad, detail, detail, AlphaMask)
--Inner
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.SetStencilZFailOperation(STENCILOPERATION_INCR)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_ALWAYS)
render.DrawSphere(pos, -math.max(rad - thick, 0), detail, detail, AlphaMask)
render.SetStencilZFailOperation(STENCILOPERATION_DECR)
-- Overall
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_ALWAYS)
render.DrawSphere(pos, math.max(rad - thick, 0), detail, detail, AlphaMask)
render.SetStencilCompareFunction(STENCILCOMPARISONFUNCTION_EQUAL)

cam.IgnoreZ(true)
render.SetStencilReferenceValue(7)
render.DrawSphere(pos, -rad, detail, detail, clr)
cam.IgnoreZ(false)
render.SetStencilEnable(false)
end

local function BuildPuzzleWallAngle(hitNormal, eyeYaw)
if not isvector(hitNormal) then return nil end

local normal = hitNormal:GetNormalized()
local ang = (-normal):Angle()
ang:RotateAroundAxis(ang:Right(), 90)
local yawDiff = math.AngleDifference(tonumber(eyeYaw) or 0, ang.y)
ang:RotateAroundAxis(normal, yawDiff)
return ang
end

local updatingAngleSliders = false

local function EnsurePreviewModel()
if IsValid(LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_Puzzle_previewModel) then return LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_Puzzle_previewModel end
LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_Puzzle_previewModel = ClientsideModel("models/props_lab/keypad.mdl", RENDERGROUP_OPAQUE)
if IsValid(LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_Puzzle_previewModel) then
LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_Puzzle_previewModel:SetNoDraw(false)

return LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_Puzzle_previewModel

local function GetAngleTableFromData(data)
if not istable(data) and not isangle(data) then return nil end
local p = tonumber(data.p)
local y = tonumber(data.y)
local r = tonumber(data.r)
if p == nil or y == nil or r == nil then return nil end
return { p = p, y = y, r = r }
end

local function ResolveActiveAngleData(objData)
if not istable(objData) then return nil end
if objData["aim_wall"] then
return GetAngleTableFromData(objData["wall_ang"])
end
return GetAngleTableFromData(objData["angle"])
end

if not istable(objData) then return end
local angData = {
p = tonumber(p) or 0,
y = tonumber(y) or 0,
r = tonumber(r) or 0,
}

if objData["aim_wall"] then
objData["wall_ang"] = angData

objData["angle"] = angData
end
end

function cutta_inventory_system:SetupPreviewModel(panel, modelPath, camScale)

panel:SetFOV(26)

if not IsValid(panel.Entity) then return end

local mins, maxs = panel.Entity:GetRenderBounds()
local size = math.max(math.abs(mins.x) + math.abs(maxs.x), math.abs(mins.y) + math.abs(maxs.y), math.abs(mins.z) + math.abs(maxs.z))
size = math.max(size, 16)

panel:SetFOV(math.Clamp(18 + (size * 0.08), 18, 42))
panel:SetCamPos(Vector(size * (camScale or 0.9), size * (camScale or 0.9), size * 0.6))
panel:SetLookAt((mins + maxs) * 0.5)

function panel:LayoutEntity()
return
end

function cutta_inventory_system:Player_TradeOfferFromUI(securitycode)
if not cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Menu_Trading"] then return end
local frame = cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Menu_Trading"]

local activeCode = tostring(frame.PanelSecurityCode or "")
local code = tostring(securitycode or "")
if code == "" then
code = activeCode
end

-- If caller passed a stale/wrong code, prefer the active trade code.
if activeCode ~= "" and code ~= activeCode then
code = activeCode
end

if activeCode ~= "" and code ~= activeCode then return end

local offer = {}
if frame.plyinventory_layout and IsValid(frame.plyinventory_layout) then
for _,itemPanel in ipairs(frame.plyinventory_layout:GetChildren()) do
if itemPanel.IsSelected and itemPanel.ItemClass and isstring(itemPanel.ItemClass) then
if cutta_inventory_system["Config"]["MaxTradableItems"] and #offer >= cutta_inventory_system["Config"]["MaxTradableItems"] then
break
end
table.insert(offer, itemPanel.ItemClass)
end
end
end

print("[CIS DEBUG] Player_TradeOfferFromUI - Offer:", table.ToString(offer))

-- Instant local UI feedback: update "Your Offer" immediately.
frame.myAccepted = false
frame.otherAccepted = false
if frame.plytrade_list and IsValid(frame.plytrade_list) then
CIS_PopulateOfferLayout(frame.plytrade_list, offer)
end

cutta_inventory_system:Player_TradeOfferUpdate(code, offer)
end

function cutta_inventory_system:Player_TradeStateUpdate(securitycode, state)
if not cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Menu_Trading"] then return end
local frame = cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Menu_Trading"]
if frame.PanelSecurityCode ~= securitycode then return end
if not istable(state) then return end

local myid = LocalPlayer():AccountID()
local myid_str = tostring(myid)

local my = state[myid] or state[myid_str] or {}
local other = {}

for k,v in pairs(state) do
if tostring(k) ~= myid_str then
other = v
break
end
end

frame.myAccepted = tobool(my.accepted)
frame.otherAccepted = tobool(other.accepted)

if frame.plytrade_list and IsValid(frame.plytrade_list) then
CIS_PopulateOfferLayout(frame.plytrade_list, my.offer or {})
end

if frame.othertrade_list and IsValid(frame.othertrade_list) then
CIS_PopulateOfferLayout(frame.othertrade_list, other.offer or {})
end
end

function cutta_inventory_system:Player_TradeOfferFromUI(securitycode)
if not cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Menu_Trading"] then return end
local frame = cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Menu_Trading"]

local activeCode = tostring(frame.PanelSecurityCode or "")
local code = tostring(securitycode or "")
if code == "" then
code = activeCode
end

-- If caller passed a stale/wrong code, prefer the active trade code.
if activeCode ~= "" and code ~= activeCode then
code = activeCode
end

if activeCode ~= "" and code ~= activeCode then return end

local offer = {}
if frame.plyinventory_layout and IsValid(frame.plyinventory_layout) then
for _,itemPanel in ipairs(frame.plyinventory_layout:GetChildren()) do
if itemPanel.IsSelected and itemPanel.ItemClass and isstring(itemPanel.ItemClass) then
if cutta_inventory_system["Config"]["MaxTradableItems"] and #offer >= cutta_inventory_system["Config"]["MaxTradableItems"] then
break
end
table.insert(offer, itemPanel.ItemClass)
end
end
end

print("[CIS DEBUG] Player_TradeOfferFromUI - Offer:", table.ToString(offer))

-- Instant local UI feedback: update "Your Offer" immediately.
frame.myAccepted = false
frame.otherAccepted = false
if frame.plytrade_list and IsValid(frame.plytrade_list) then
CIS_PopulateOfferLayout(frame.plytrade_list, offer)
end

cutta_inventory_system:Player_TradeOfferUpdate(code, offer)
end

function cutta_inventory_system:Player_TradeStateUpdate(securitycode, state)
if not cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Menu_Trading"] then return end
local frame = cutta_inventory_system["Data"]["Menu_Trading"]
if frame.PanelSecurityCode ~= securitycode then return end
if not istable(state) then return end

local myid = LocalPlayer():AccountID()
local myid_str = tostring(myid)

local my = state[myid] or state[myid_str] or {}
local other = {}

for k,v in pairs(state) do
if tostring(k) ~= myid_str then
other = v
break
end
end

frame.myAccepted = tobool(my.accepted)
frame.otherAccepted = tobool(other.accepted)

if frame.plytrade_list and IsValid(frame.plytrade_list) then
CIS_PopulateOfferLayout(frame.plytrade_list, my.offer or {})
end

if frame.othertrade_list and IsValid(frame.othertrade_list) then
CIS_PopulateOfferLayout(frame.othertrade_list, other.offer or {})
end
end

local function LoadFiles()
local allFiles = file.Find("cutta_inventory_system/*.lua", "LUA")
local sv_files = {}
local cl_files = {}
local shared_files = {}

local known_shared_files = {
"shared_config.lua",
"shared_hooks.lua",
"shared_functions.lua"
}
local shared_file_set = {}
for _, filename in ipairs(known_shared_files) do
shared_file_set[filename] = true
end

shared_files[#shared_files + 1] = d
else
local first3 = string.sub(d, 1, 3)
if first3 == "sv_" then
sv_files[#sv_files + 1] = d
elseif first3 == "cl_" then
cl_files[#cl_files + 1] = d
end
end
end

local shared_files = {}

local known_shared_files = {
"shared_config.lua",
"shared_hooks.lua",
"shared_functions.lua"
}
local shared_file_set = {}
for _, filename in ipairs(known_shared_files) do
shared_file_set[filename] = true
end

for _, d in ipairs(allFiles) do
if shared_file_set[d] then
shared_files[#shared_files + 1] = d
else
local first3 = string.sub(d, 1, 3)
if first3 == "sv_" then
sv_files[#sv_files + 1] = d
elseif first3 == "cl_" then
cl_files[#cl_files + 1] = d
end
end
end

table.sort(shared_files)
table.sort(cl_files)
table.sort(sv_files)

local function loadShared(filename)
local filePath = "cutta_inventory_system/" .. filename
if file.Exists(filePath, "LUA") then
if SERVER then
AddCSLuaFile(filePath)
end
include(filePath)
print("Cutta Inventory Shared Loaded: " .. filename)
end
end

if SERVER then
-- Shared: include shared files explicitly first
for _, filename in ipairs(known_shared_files) do
loadShared(filename)
end

-- Server-side cl_: AddCSLuaFile only
for _, d in ipairs(cl_files) do
local filePath = string.gsub(d, "\\", "/")
AddCSLuaFile("cutta_inventory_system/" .. filePath)
print("Cutta Inventory Loaded: " .. filePath)
end
-- Server-side sv_: include

local filePath = string.gsub(d, "\\", "/")
include("cutta_inventory_system/" .. filePath)
print("Cutta Inventory Loaded: " .. filePath)
end
else
-- Client: include shared files explicitly first
for _, filename in ipairs(known_shared_files) do
loadShared(filename)

for _, d in ipairs(cl_files) do
local filePath = string.gsub(d, "\\", "/")

print("Cutta Inventory Loaded: " .. filePath)
end
end

timer.Remove(ply:Nick()..""..skill.skillid)
end
end

skill.death = function(ply)
if timer.Exists(ply:Nick()..""..skill.skillid) then
timer.Remove(ply:Nick()..""..skill.skillid)
end
end

question: Show a simple Garry's Mod example of a server-owned inventory syncing to a client UI.
answer:
Server
```lua
util.AddNetworkString("MyAddon_InventorySync")

local function sync_inventory(ply)
if not IsValid(ply) then return end
net.Start("MyAddon_InventorySync")
net.WriteString(util.TableToJSON(ply.MyInventory or {}, false) or "[]")
net.Send(ply)
end

hook.Add("PlayerInitialSpawn", "MyAddon_InitInventory", function(ply)
ply.MyInventory = {{id = "medkit", amount = 2}, {id = "battery", amount = 1}}
sync_inventory(ply)
end)
```

Client
```lua
local inventory = {}

net.Receive("MyAddon_InventorySync", function()
inventory = util.JSONToTable(net.ReadString()) or {}
end)
```

The server owns the inventory. The client only displays a synchronized copy.

question: Write the Garry's Mod addon file "cutta_cosmetic_shop/lua/cutta_cosmetic_shop/sv_cuttacoins.lua".
answer:
--
function cutta_cosmetic_shop:COINS_ADD(ply,amount)
if not IsValid(ply) then return end
ply["Cutta_Cosmetic_plydata"] = ply["Cutta_Cosmetic_plydata"] or {}
ply["Cutta_Cosmetic_plydata"]["C_COINS"] = cutta_cosmetic_shop:COINS_GET(ply) + amount
cutta_cosmetic_shop:Transfer(ply)
end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:COINS_SET(ply,amount)
if not IsValid(ply) then return end
ply["Cutta_Cosmetic_plydata"] = ply["Cutta_Cosmetic_plydata"] or {}
ply["Cutta_Cosmetic_plydata"]["C_COINS"] = tonumber(amount) or 0
cutta_cosmetic_shop:Transfer(ply)
end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:PREMIUM_COINS_ADD(ply,amount)
if not IsValid(ply) then return end
ply["Cutta_Cosmetic_plydata"] = ply["Cutta_Cosmetic_plydata"] or {}
ply["Cutta_Cosmetic_plydata"]["C_PREMIUM_COINS"] = cutta_cosmetic_shop:PREMIUM_COINS_GET(ply) + amount
cutta_cosmetic_shop:Transfer(ply)
end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:PREMIUM_COINS_SET(ply,amount)
if not IsValid(ply) then return end
ply["Cutta_Cosmetic_plydata"] = ply["Cutta_Cosmetic_plydata"] or {}
ply["Cutta_Cosmetic_plydata"]["C_PREMIUM_COINS"] = tonumber(amount) or 0
cutta_cosmetic_shop:Transfer(ply)
end

local function sanitize_requested_conversion_count(requestedCount)
return math.min(math.max(math.floor(tonumber(requestedCount) or 1), 1), 65535)
end

local function format_exchange_suffix(exchangeCount)
exchangeCount = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(exchangeCount) or 0), 0)
if exchangeCount <= 1 then
return ""
end

return " across " .. string.Comma(exchangeCount) .. " exchanges"
end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:ConvertDarkRPMoneyToCoins(ply, requestedCount)
if not IsValid(ply) then
return false, "Player is not valid."
end

if not DarkRP then
return false, "DarkRP is not active on this server."
end

if not isfunction(ply.getDarkRPVar) or not isfunction(ply.addMoney) then
return false, "DarkRP money is unavailable right now."
end

local moneyCost, coinReward = self:GetDarkRPMoneyCoinExchangeRate()
if moneyCost <= 0 or coinReward <= 0 then
return false, "The exchange rate is invalid."
end

local currentMoney = self:GetDarkRPMoney(ply)
local affordableCount = math.floor(math.max(currentMoney, 0) / moneyCost)
if affordableCount < 1 then
return false, "You need $" .. string.Comma(moneyCost) .. " DarkRP money to convert."
end

local convertCount = math.min(sanitize_requested_conversion_count(requestedCount), affordableCount)
local totalMoneyCost = moneyCost * convertCount
local totalCoinReward = coinReward * convertCount

if isfunction(ply.canAfford) and not ply:canAfford(totalMoneyCost) then
return false, "You need $" .. string.Comma(totalMoneyCost) .. " DarkRP money to convert."
end

local removedMoney = pcall(function()
ply:addMoney(-totalMoneyCost)
end)
if not removedMoney then
return false, "Failed to remove DarkRP money."
end

self:COINS_ADD(ply, totalCoinReward)
return true, "Converted $" .. string.Comma(totalMoneyCost) .. " DarkRP money into " .. string.Comma(totalCoinReward) .. " cosmetic coins" .. format_exchange_suffix(convertCount) .. "."
end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:ConvertInventoryMoneyToCoins(ply, requestedCount)
if not IsValid(ply) then
return false, "Player is not valid."
end

if not cutta_inventory_system or not isfunction(cutta_inventory_system.Get_PlayerMoney) or not isfunction(cutta_inventory_system.Player_MoneyGive) then
return false, "Cutta Inventory money is unavailable on this server."
end

if DarkRP then
return false, "Cutta Inventory is currently using DarkRP money. Use the DarkRP conversion instead."
end

local moneyCost, coinReward = self:GetInventoryMoneyCoinExchangeRate()
if moneyCost <= 0 or coinReward <= 0 then
return false, "The exchange rate is invalid."
end

local currentMoney = self:GetInventoryMoney(ply)
local affordableCount = math.floor(math.max(currentMoney, 0) / moneyCost)
if affordableCount < 1 then
return false, "You need $" .. string.Comma(moneyCost) .. " Cutta Inventory money to convert."
end

local convertCount = math.min(sanitize_requested_conversion_count(requestedCount), affordableCount)
local totalMoneyCost = moneyCost * convertCount
local totalCoinReward = coinReward * convertCount

local removedMoney = pcall(function()
cutta_inventory_system:Player_MoneyGive(ply, -totalMoneyCost, "Cosmetic coin conversion")
end)
if not removedMoney then
return false, "Failed to remove Cutta Inventory money."
end

self:COINS_ADD(ply, totalCoinReward)
return true, "Converted $" .. string.Comma(totalMoneyCost) .. " Cutta Inventory money into " .. string.Comma(totalCoinReward) .. " cosmetic coins" .. format_exchange_suffix(convertCount) .. "."
end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:ConvertCoinsToPremium(ply, requestedCount)
if not IsValid(ply) then
return false, "Player is not valid."
end

local coinCost, premiumReward = self:GetCoinsPremiumExchangeRate()
if coinCost <= 0 or premiumReward <= 0 then
return false, "The exchange rate is invalid."
end

local currentCoins = self:COINS_GET(ply)
local affordableCount = math.floor(math.max(currentCoins, 0) / coinCost)
if affordableCount < 1 then
return false, "You need " .. string.Comma(coinCost) .. " cosmetic coins to convert."
end

local convertCount = math.min(sanitize_requested_conversion_count(requestedCount), affordableCount)
local totalCoinCost = coinCost * convertCount
local totalPremiumReward = premiumReward * convertCount

ply["Cutta_Cosmetic_plydata"] = ply["Cutta_Cosmetic_plydata"] or {}
ply["Cutta_Cosmetic_plydata"]["C_COINS"] = math.max(currentCoins - totalCoinCost, 0)
ply["Cutta_Cosmetic_plydata"]["C_PREMIUM_COINS"] = self:PREMIUM_COINS_GET(ply) + totalPremiumReward
self:Transfer(ply)

return true, "Converted " .. string.Comma(totalCoinCost) .. " cosmetic coins into " .. string.Comma(totalPremiumReward) .. " premium coins" .. format_exchange_suffix(convertCount) .. "."
end

question: Show an example of how to use cam.PushModelMatrix in Garry's Mod Lua.
answer:
Example

Simple function to draw rotated and/or scaled text.
```lua
local vector_one = Vector( 1, 1, 1 )
function draw.RotatedText( text, font, x, y, color, ang, scale )
render.PushFilterMag( TEXFILTER.ANISOTROPIC )
render.PushFilterMin( TEXFILTER.ANISOTROPIC )

local m = Matrix()
m:Translate( Vector( x, y, 0 ) )
m:Rotate( Angle( 0, ang, 0 ) )
m:Scale( vector_one * ( scale or 1 ) )

surface.SetFont( font )
local w, h = surface.GetTextSize( text )

m:Translate( Vector( -w / 2, -h / 2, 0 ) )

cam.PushModelMatrix( m, true )
draw.DrawText( text, font, 0, 0, color )
cam.PopModelMatrix()

render.PopFilterMag()
render.PopFilterMin()
end

hook.Add("HUDPaint", "2d rotation test", function()
local w, h = ScrW(), ScrH()
local ang = RealTime() * 50
local scale = ( math.sin( ang / 10 ) + 2 ) * 0.5
draw.RotatedText( "My fancy Rotating Text", "DermaLarge", w / 2, h / 2, color_white, ang, scale )
end)
```

Rotating a box while keeping it's matrix positions relative to the panel.
```lua
concommand.Add("test_matrix", function()
local menu = vgui.Create( "DFrame" )
menu:SetSize( 200, 200 )
menu:SetTitle("Matrix rotation example")
menu:SetPos( 200, 200 )

local panel = menu:Add( "DPanel" )
panel:SetSize( 100, 100 )
panel:Center()

local grin = Material("icon16/emoticon_evilgrin.png", "smooth noclamp")
local angle = 0
function panel:Paint(w, h)
draw.RoundedBox( 8, 0, 0, w, h, color_white )

-- time to draw our matrix
local m = Matrix()

-- to keep the matrix relative to the panel, we get the center of it relative to the screen
local x, y = self:LocalToScreen( w / 2, h / 2 )
local center = Vector( x, y, 0 )

m:Translate( center )
m:Rotate( Angle( 0, angle, 0 ) )
m:Translate( -center )

-- rotate the angle after drawing for next time
angle = angle + FrameTime() * 60

-- push a filter mag to take away the crispiness
render.PushFilterMag( TEXFILTER.ANISOTROPIC )
render.PushFilterMin( TEXFILTER.ANISOTROPIC )

cam.PushModelMatrix( m )
draw.RoundedBox( 8, 0, 0, w, h, color_black )
surface.SetDrawColor( 255, 255, 255, 255 )
surface.SetMaterial( grin )
surface.DrawTexturedRect( w/2-16, h/2-16, 32, 32 )
cam.PopModelMatrix()

render.PopFilterMag()
render.PopFilterMin()
end

end)
```

function cutta_quest_system:Menu_Objective_puzzle(frame, value, index, questname)

local function BuildPuzzleWallAngle(hitNormal, eyeYaw)
if not isvector(hitNormal) then return nil end

local normal = hitNormal:GetNormalized()
local ang = (-normal):Angle()
ang:RotateAroundAxis(ang:Right(), 90)
local yawDiff = math.AngleDifference(tonumber(eyeYaw) or 0, ang.y)
ang:RotateAroundAxis(normal, yawDiff)
return ang
end

local updatingAngleSliders = false

local function EnsurePreviewModel()
if IsValid(LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_Puzzle_previewModel) then return LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_Puzzle_previewModel end
LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_Puzzle_previewModel = ClientsideModel("models/props_lab/keypad.mdl", RENDERGROUP_OPAQUE)
if IsValid(LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_Puzzle_previewModel) then
LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_Puzzle_previewModel:SetNoDraw(false)
end
return LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_Puzzle_previewModel
end

local function RemovePreviewModel()
if IsValid(LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_Puzzle_previewModel) then
LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_Puzzle_previewModel:Remove()
end
LocalPlayer().CUTTAQS_Puzzle_previewModel = nil
end

local function GetAngleTableFromData(data)
if not istable(data) and not isangle(data) then return nil end
local p = tonumber(data.p)
local y = tonumber(data.y)
local r = tonumber(data.r)
if p == nil or y == nil or r == nil then return nil end
return { p = p, y = y, r = r }
end

local function ResolveActiveAngleData(objData)
if not istable(objData) then return nil end
if objData["aim_wall"] then
return GetAngleTableFromData(objData["wall_ang"])
end
return GetAngleTableFromData(objData["angle"])
end

local function SetActiveAngleData(objData, p, y, r)
if not istable(objData) then return end
local angData = {
p = tonumber(p) or 0,
y = tonumber(y) or 0,
r = tonumber(r) or 0,
}

if objData["aim_wall"] then
objData["wall_ang"] = angData
else
objData["angle"] = angData
end
end

local objData = cutta_quest_system.QuestMenu_MainQuestFrame["Quests"].Menu_Quest_ObjectiveEdit_Frame.ObjData

RemovePreviewModel()
return
end

local mdl = EnsurePreviewModel()

local previewPos
local previewAng
if objData["aim_wall"] then
local wallAng = GetAngleTableFromData(objData["wall_ang"])
if wallAng then
previewPos = objData["position"]

end
else

if freeAng then
previewPos = objData["position"] + Vector(0, 0, 24)
previewAng = Angle(freeAng.p, freeAng.y + 180, freeAng.r)
end
end

if not isvector(previewPos) or not isangle(previewAng) then
RemovePreviewModel()

end

mdl:SetPos(previewPos)
mdl:SetAngles(previewAng)
end

local oldOnRemove = frame.OnRemove
frame.OnRemove = function(pan)
RemovePreviewModel()
if oldOnRemove then
oldOnRemove(pan)
end
end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:AttachPropToPlayer(ply, modelPath, boneName, posOffset, angOffset, cosmeticID)

if not IsValid(ply) then return end

local ent = ClientsideModel(modelPath)

if not IsValid(ent) then return end

ent:SetNoDraw(true) -- Keep model no-draw; we'll render it in PostPlayerDraw so it's visible to all clients

ent:SetModel(modelPath)

ent:SetupBones()

local boneID = ply:LookupBone(boneName or "")

if not boneID then boneID = 0 end

posOffset = posOffset or Vector(0,0,0)

angOffset = angOffset or Angle(0,0,0)

ent._cosmetic_owner = ply

ent._cosmetic_id = cosmeticID

return ent

end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:ApplyCharacterProps(ply)

if not IsValid(ply) then return end

local cosmeticData = ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"]

if not cosmeticData then return end

ply.Cutta_AttachedProps = ply.Cutta_AttachedProps or {}

-- Remove props not in saved list

for id, ent in pairs(ply.Cutta_AttachedProps) do

if not cosmeticData[id] or not cosmeticData[id].added then

if IsValid(ent) then ent:Remove() end

ply.Cutta_AttachedProps[id] = nil

end

end

-- Create props for each saved item

for id, data in pairs(cosmeticData) do

if data.added then

local item = cutta_cosmetic_shop:ITEM_GETTABLE(id)

if not item then continue end

local expectedModel = cutta_cosmetic_shop:NormalizeModelPath(item.Model)

local modelMissing = expectedModel ~= "" and cutta_cosmetic_shop:Client_ModelMissing(expectedModel)

local ent = ply.Cutta_AttachedProps[id]

-- If the model is missing, remove any ERROR entity and try a workshop download

if modelMissing then

if IsValid(ent) then

ent:Remove()

ply.Cutta_AttachedProps[id] = nil

end

if cutta_cosmetic_shop.Client_RequestItemWorkshopDownload

and cutta_cosmetic_shop.Client_WorkshopAutoDownloadEnabled

and cutta_cosmetic_shop:Client_WorkshopAutoDownloadEnabled() then

cutta_cosmetic_shop:Client_RequestItemWorkshopDownload(id)

end

continue

end

-- If entity exists but shows the wrong model (e.g. error.mdl), recreate it

if IsValid(ent) then

local currentModel = cutta_cosmetic_shop:NormalizeModelPath(ent:GetModel() or "")

if currentModel ~= expectedModel and expectedModel ~= "" then

ent:Remove()

ply.Cutta_AttachedProps[id] = nil

ent = nil

end

end

if not IsValid(ent) then

ent = cutta_cosmetic_shop:AttachPropToPlayer(

ply,

item.Model,

data.boneselect,

Vector(data.posx, data.posy, data.posz),

Angle(data.pitch, data.yaw, data.roll),

id

)

ply.Cutta_AttachedProps[id] = ent

-- If this item is a pet, attempt to play its stored pet animation once

if item.IsPet == "true" and item.PetAnimation and IsValid(ent) then

local seq = ent:LookupSequence(item.PetAnimation)

if seq and seq >= 0 then

ent:ResetSequence(seq)

ent:SetCycle(0)

ent:SetPlaybackRate(1)

end

end

end

-- Apply scale (always clamped <= 1)

if IsValid(ent) and ent.SetModelScale then

local scale = cutta_cosmetic_shop:ClampCosmeticScale(data.scale)

ent:SetModelScale(scale, 0)

end

end

end

end

hook.Add("PostPlayerDraw", "CuttaCosmetics_Render", function(ply)

if not IsValid(ply) or not ply:Alive() then return end

if ply == LocalPlayer() and GetViewEntity() and GetViewEntity():GetClass() == 'player' and (GetConVar('thirdperson') and GetConVar('thirdperson'):GetInt() == 0) then return end

if not ply.Cutta_AttachedProps or next(ply.Cutta_AttachedProps) == nil or not ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"] then return end

local savedProps = ply["CuttaCosmetics_TempProps"] or {}

if next(savedProps) == nil then return end

local canrender = hook.Run("CuttaCosmetics_PreRender_Check", ply)

if canrender == false then return end

-- Ensure bones are available for this player

if ply.InvalidateBoneCache then

ply:InvalidateBoneCache()

end

if ply.SetupBones then

ply:SetupBones()

end

for id, model in pairs(ply.Cutta_AttachedProps) do

if not IsValid(model) then

ply.Cutta_AttachedProps[id] = nil

else

local data = savedProps[id]

if not data or not data.added then

-- nothing to draw for this id

else

-- Lookup bone index via name if provided, else fallback to 0

local boneName = data.boneselect

local boneIndex = ply:LookupBone(boneName or "")

if not boneIndex or boneIndex < 0 then

boneIndex = 0

end

-- Try to get a bone matrix for exact transforms

local bonePos, boneAng

local mat

if ply.GetBoneMatrix and boneIndex and boneIndex >= 0 then

mat = ply:GetBoneMatrix(boneIndex)

end

if mat then

bonePos = mat:GetTranslation()

boneAng = mat:GetAngles()

else

-- fallback to GetBonePosition which returns pos/ang

local pos1, ang1 = ply:GetBonePosition(boneIndex)

if pos1 and ang1 then

bonePos = pos1

boneAng = ang1

else

-- as last resort use the player's origin

bonePos = ply:GetPos()

boneAng = ply:GetAngles()

end

end

local localPos = Vector(data.posx or 0, data.posy or 0, data.posz or 0)

local localAng = Angle(data.pitch or 0, data.yaw or 0, data.roll or 0)

local finalPos, finalAng = LocalToWorld(localPos, localAng, bonePos, boneAng)

-- advance animation for pet attachments if configured

if data.petanimation then

local idx = model:LookupSequence(data.petanimation)

if idx and idx >= 0 then

if model:GetSequence() ~= idx then

model:ResetSequence(idx)

model:SetCycle(0)

end

model:SetPlaybackRate(1)

model:FrameAdvance(FrameTime())

end

end

model:SetPos(finalPos)

model:SetAngles(finalAng)

model:SetRenderOrigin(finalPos)

model:SetRenderAngles(finalAng)

-- Apply scale each draw so live edits/preset loads update without recreating the model

if model.SetModelScale then

local scale = cutta_cosmetic_shop:ClampCosmeticScale(data.scale)

model:SetModelScale(scale, 0)

end

-- update bones of the clientside model before drawing

if model.InvalidateBoneCache then model:InvalidateBoneCache() end

if model.SetupBones then model:SetupBones() end

model:DrawModel()

end

end

end

end)

local function TryPlayAnimationSequence(target, animationName)

if not IsValid(target) then return false end

local resolvedAnimation = string.Trim(tostring(animationName or ""))

if resolvedAnimation == "" then return false end

local sequence = target:LookupSequence(resolvedAnimation)

if not sequence or sequence < 0 then

local lowerAnimation = string.lower(resolvedAnimation)

local sequenceCount = math.max((target:GetSequenceCount() or 0) - 1, -1)

for index = 0, sequenceCount do

local sequenceName = target:GetSequenceName(index)

if sequenceName and string.find(string.lower(sequenceName), lowerAnimation, 1, true) then

sequence = index

break

end

end

end

if not sequence or sequence < 0 then return false end

target:ResetSequence(sequence, true)

target:SetCycle(0)

target:SetPlaybackRate(1)

return true

end

attach.CuttaPetAnim = petanim

end

local function RunWorkshopDownloadCallbacks(workshopID, success)

local runtimeState = cutta_cosmetic_shop["WorkshopRuntimeDownloads"]

runtimeState.callbacks = runtimeState.callbacks or {}

local callbacks = runtimeState.callbacks[workshopID]

runtimeState.callbacks[workshopID] = nil

if not istable(callbacks) then return end

for i = 1, #callbacks do

local callbackEntry = callbacks[i]

local callback = callbackEntry

local callbackAssetPath = nil

local callbackCosmeticID = nil

local callbackAssetType = "model"

if istable(callbackEntry) then

callback = callbackEntry.callback

callbackAssetType = callbackEntry.assetType == "sound" and "sound" or "model"

if callbackAssetType == "sound" then

callbackAssetPath = cutta_cosmetic_shop:NormalizeSoundPath(callbackEntry.assetPath or callbackEntry.modelPath)

else

callbackAssetPath = cutta_cosmetic_shop:NormalizeModelPath(callbackEntry.assetPath or callbackEntry.modelPath)

end

callbackCosmeticID = callbackEntry.cosmeticID

end

local callbackSuccess = success == true

if callbackSuccess and callbackAssetPath ~= nil and callbackAssetPath ~= "" then

if callbackAssetType == "sound" then

callbackSuccess = not cutta_cosmetic_shop:Client_SoundMissing(callbackAssetPath)

else

callbackSuccess = not cutta_cosmetic_shop:Client_ModelMissing(callbackAssetPath)

end

end

if isfunction(callback) then

pcall(callback, callbackSuccess, callbackAssetPath, callbackCosmeticID, workshopID, callbackAssetType)

end

end

and cutta_cosmetic_shop:NormalizeSoundPath(assetPath)

or cutta_cosmetic_shop:NormalizeModelPath(assetPath)

runtimeState.callbacks[workshopID][#runtimeState.callbacks[workshopID] + 1] = {

cosmeticID = cosmeticID ~= nil and tostring(cosmeticID) or nil

local directId = string.match(trimmed, "^(%d+)$")

if directId then

return directId

local queryId = string.match(trimmed, "[?&]id=(%d+)")

if queryId then

return queryId

end

return string.match(trimmed, "/(%d+)/?$")

end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:Client_RequestWorkshopDownload(workshopID, assetPath, cosmeticID, onComplete, assetType)

local runtimeState = self["WorkshopRuntimeDownloads"]

runtimeState.callbacks = runtimeState.callbacks or {}

assetType = assetType == "sound" and "sound" or "model"

workshopID = tostring(workshopID or ExtractWorkshopID((self:ITEM_GETTABLE(cosmeticID) or {}).WorkshopLink or "") or "")

if workshopID == "" then return false end

if assetType == "sound" then

assetPath = self:NormalizeSoundPath(assetPath)

else

assetPath = self:NormalizeModelPath(assetPath)

end

if assetPath == "" then return false end

local assetMissing = false

if assetType == "sound" then

assetMissing = self:Client_SoundMissing(assetPath)

else

assetMissing = self:Client_ModelMissing(assetPath)

end

if not assetMissing then

if isfunction(onComplete) then

pcall(onComplete, true, assetPath, cosmeticID, workshopID, assetType)

end

return true

end

if runtimeState.pending[workshopID] then

QueueWorkshopDownloadCallback(workshopID, assetPath, cosmeticID, onComplete, assetType)

return true

end

if runtimeState.mounted[workshopID] then

local stillMissing = false

if assetType == "sound" then

stillMissing = self:Client_SoundMissing(assetPath, true)

else

stillMissing = self:Client_ModelMissing(assetPath, true)

end

if not stillMissing then

if isfunction(onComplete) then

pcall(onComplete, true, assetPath, cosmeticID, workshopID, assetType)

end

return true

end

-- Recover from stale "mounted" states where files are still unresolved on this client.

runtimeState.mounted[workshopID] = nil

runtimeState.failedUntil[workshopID] = CurTime() + retryDelay

if assetType == "sound" then

ClearClientSoundAvailabilityCache(assetPath)

else

ClearClientModelAvailabilityCache(assetPath)

end

if isfunction(onComplete) then

pcall(onComplete, false, assetPath, cosmeticID, workshopID, assetType)

end

return false

end

if not CanRuntimeDownloadWorkshop(workshopID) then

if isfunction(onComplete) then

pcall(onComplete, false, assetPath, cosmeticID, workshopID, assetType)

end

return false

end

QueueWorkshopDownloadCallback(workshopID, assetPath, cosmeticID, onComplete, assetType)

runtimeState.pending[workshopID] = true

steamworks.DownloadUGC(workshopID, function(path)

runtimeState.pending[workshopID] = nil

if not path or path == "" then

runtimeState.failedUntil[workshopID] = CurTime() + retryDelay

RunWorkshopDownloadCallbacks(workshopID, false)

return

end

local mounted, mountedFiles = game.MountGMA(path)

if mounted == false then

runtimeState.failedUntil[workshopID] = CurTime() + retryDelay

RunWorkshopDownloadCallbacks(workshopID, false)

return

end

runtimeState.mounted[workshopID] = true

runtimeState.failedUntil[workshopID] = nil

ClearClientModelAvailabilityCache()

ClearClientSoundAvailabilityCache()

-- Defer refresh to next frame so the engine fully registers mounted files

timer.Simple(0, function()

ClearClientModelAvailabilityCache()

ClearClientSoundAvailabilityCache()

RefreshPlayersUsingMountedWorkshop(workshopID)

RunWorkshopDownloadCallbacks(workshopID, true)

end)

end)

return true

end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:Client_RequestWorkshopHotload(workshopID, onComplete)

runtimeState.callbacks = runtimeState.callbacks or {}

workshopID = tostring(workshopID or "")

if workshopID == "" then return false end

if runtimeState.pending[workshopID] then

QueueWorkshopDownloadCallback(workshopID, nil, nil, onComplete)

end

if runtimeState.mounted[workshopID] then

if isfunction(onComplete) then

pcall(onComplete, true, nil, nil, workshopID, "manual")

end

return true

end

if not CanRuntimeDownloadWorkshop(workshopID) then

if isfunction(onComplete) then

pcall(onComplete, false, nil, nil, workshopID, "manual")

end

return false

end

QueueWorkshopDownloadCallback(workshopID, nil, nil, onComplete)

runtimeState.pending[workshopID] = true

runtimeState.pending[workshopID] = nil

if not path or path == "" then

runtimeState.failedUntil[workshopID] = CurTime() + retryDelay

RunWorkshopDownloadCallbacks(workshopID, false)

return

end

local mounted = game.MountGMA(path)

if mounted == false then

runtimeState.failedUntil[workshopID] = CurTime() + retryDelay

RunWorkshopDownloadCallbacks(workshopID, false)

return

end

runtimeState.mounted[workshopID] = true

runtimeState.failedUntil[workshopID] = nil

ClearClientModelAvailabilityCache()

ClearClientSoundAvailabilityCache()

timer.Simple(0, function()

ClearClientModelAvailabilityCache()

ClearClientSoundAvailabilityCache()

RefreshPlayersUsingMountedWorkshop(workshopID)

RunWorkshopDownloadCallbacks(workshopID, true)

end)

end)

end

local function GetConfiguredSoundBindVolumeScale()

local function BuildWorkshopSoundCandidates(soundID, preferredSoundPath)

local candidates = {}

local seenCandidates = {}

local function addCandidate(soundPath)

local normalizedSound = cutta_cosmetic_shop:NormalizeSoundPath(soundPath)

if normalizedSound == "" or seenCandidates[normalizedSound] then return end

seenCandidates[normalizedSound] = true

candidates[#candidates + 1] = normalizedSound

end

addCandidate(preferredSoundPath)

local item = cutta_cosmetic_shop:ITEM_GETTABLE(soundID)

if not item or item.IsSound ~= "true" then

return candidates

end

addCandidate(item.Sound)

if istable(item.WorkshopSounds) then

for _, workshopSound in ipairs(item.WorkshopSounds) do

addCandidate(workshopSound)

end

end

return candidates

end

local function ResolveMountedWorkshopSound(soundID, preferredSoundPath)

local candidates = BuildWorkshopSoundCandidates(soundID, preferredSoundPath)

for i = 1, #candidates do

local candidateSound = candidates[i]

if not cutta_cosmetic_shop:Client_SoundMissing(candidateSound) then

return candidateSound, candidates

end

end

return "", candidates

end

local function PlayLocalCosmeticSound(soundPath, sourcePos, maxDistance, sourceEntity)

local normalizedSound = cutta_cosmetic_shop:NormalizeSoundPath(soundPath)

if normalizedSound == "" then return false end

if not isvector(sourcePos) then return false end

local localPly = LocalPlayer()

if not IsValid(localPly) then return false end

local maxDistanceValue = math.max(tonumber(maxDistance) or 800, 1)

local distance = localPly:GetPos():Distance(sourcePos)

if distance > maxDistanceValue then return false end

local volumeScale = GetConfiguredSoundBindVolumeScale() * math.max(1 - (distance / maxDistanceValue), 0)

volumeScale = math.Clamp(volumeScale, 0, 1)

if volumeScale <= 0 then return false end

if IsValid(sourceEntity) and sourceEntity:IsPlayer() then

sourceEntity:EmitSound(normalizedSound, 75, 100, volumeScale)

else

sound.Play(normalizedSound, sourcePos, 75, 100, volumeScale)

end

return true

end

local function HandleIncomingLocalCosmeticSound(sourcePly, fallbackSourcePos, soundID, soundPath, workshopID, workshopLink, maxDistance)

local item = cutta_cosmetic_shop:ITEM_GETTABLE(soundID)

local mountedSoundPath, soundCandidates = ResolveMountedWorkshopSound(soundID, soundPath)

local normalizedSound = mountedSoundPath

if normalizedSound == "" and istable(soundCandidates) and #soundCandidates > 0 then

normalizedSound = soundCandidates[1]

end

if normalizedSound == "" then return end

if workshopID == nil or workshopID == "" then

workshopID = tostring((item and item.WorkshopID) or ExtractWorkshopID(workshopLink or (item and item.WorkshopLink) or "") or "")

end

local sourcePos = isvector(fallbackSourcePos) and fallbackSourcePos or (IsValid(sourcePly) and sourcePly:GetPos() or nil)

if not isvector(sourcePos) then return end

if mountedSoundPath ~= "" then

PlayLocalCosmeticSound(mountedSoundPath, sourcePos, maxDistance, sourcePly)

return

end

if workshopID == "" then return end

cutta_cosmetic_shop:Client_RequestWorkshopDownload(workshopID, normalizedSound, soundID, function(_, downloadedSoundPath)

local currentSourcePos = isvector(fallbackSourcePos) and fallbackSourcePos or (IsValid(sourcePly) and sourcePly:GetPos() or nil)

if not isvector(currentSourcePos) then return end

local resolvedDownloadedSound = ResolveMountedWorkshopSound(soundID, downloadedSoundPath or normalizedSound)

if resolvedDownloadedSound == "" then return end

PlayLocalCosmeticSound(resolvedDownloadedSound, currentSourcePos, maxDistance, sourcePly)

end, "sound")

end

function cutta_cosmetic_shop:Client_RequestWorkshopDownload(workshopID, assetPath, cosmeticID, onComplete, assetType)

local runtimeState = self["WorkshopRuntimeDownloads"]

runtimeState.callbacks = runtimeState.callbacks or {}

assetType = assetType == "sound" and "sound" or "model"

workshopID = tostring(workshopID or ExtractWorkshopID((self:ITEM_GETTABLE(cosmeticID) or {}).WorkshopLink or "") or "")

if workshopID == "" then return false end

if assetType == "sound" then

assetPath = self:NormalizeSoundPath(assetPath)

else

assetPath = self:NormalizeModelPath(assetPath)

end

if assetPath == "" then return false end

local assetMissing = false

if assetType == "sound" then

assetMissing = self:Client_SoundMissing(assetPath)

else

assetMissing = self:Client_ModelMissing(assetPath)

end

if not assetMissing then

if isfunction(onComplete) then

pcall(onComplete, true, assetPath, cosmeticID, workshopID, assetType)

end

return true

end

if runtimeState.pending[workshopID] then

QueueWorkshopDownloadCallback(workshopID, assetPath, cosmeticID, onComplete, assetType)

return true

end

if runtimeState.mounted[workshopID] then

local stillMissing = false

if assetType == "sound" then

stillMissing = self:Client_SoundMissing(assetPath, true)

else

stillMissing = self:Client_ModelMissing(assetPath, true)

end

if not stillMissing then

if isfunction(onComplete) then

pcall(onComplete, true, assetPath, cosmeticID, workshopID, assetType)

end

return true

end

-- Recover from stale "mounted" states where files are still unresolved on this client.

runtimeState.mounted[workshopID] = nil

runtimeState.failedUntil[workshopID] = CurTime() + retryDelay

if assetType == "sound" then

ClearClientSoundAvailabilityCache(assetPath)

else

ClearClientModelAvailabilityCache(assetPath)

end

if isfunction(onComplete) then

pcall(onComplete, false, assetPath, cosmeticID, workshopID, assetType)

end

return false

end

if not CanRuntimeDownloadWorkshop(workshopID) then

if isfunction(onComplete) then

pcall(onComplete, false, assetPath, cosmeticID, workshopID, assetType)

end

return false

end

QueueWorkshopDownloadCallback(workshopID, assetPath, cosmeticID, onComplete, assetType)

runtimeState.pending[workshopID] = true

steamworks.DownloadUGC(workshopID, function(path)

runtimeState.pending[workshopID] = nil

if not path or path == "" then

runtimeState.failedUntil[workshopID] = CurTime() + retryDelay

RunWorkshopDownloadCallbacks(workshopID, false)

return

end

local mounted, mountedFiles = game.MountGMA(path)

if mounted == false then

runtimeState.failedUntil[workshopID] = CurTime() + retryDelay

RunWorkshopDownloadCallbacks(workshopID, false)

return

end

runtimeState.mounted[workshopID] = true

runtimeState.failedUntil[workshopID] = nil

ClearClientModelAvailabilityCache()

ClearClientSoundAvailabilityCache()

-- Defer refresh to next frame so the engine fully registers mounted files

timer.Simple(0, function()

ClearClientModelAvailabilityCache()

ClearClientSoundAvailabilityCache()

RefreshPlayersUsingMountedWorkshop(workshopID)

RunWorkshopDownloadCallbacks(workshopID, true)

end)

end)

return true

end

QueueWorkshopDownloadCallback(workshopID, nil, nil, onComplete)

if runtimeState.mounted[workshopID] then

if isfunction(onComplete) then

if isfunction(onComplete) then

if not path or path == "" then

end)

local maxDistanceValue = math.max(tonumber(maxDistance) or 800, 1)

question: Show an example of how to use Concepts - BaseClasses in Garry's Mod Lua.
answer:
Example

The following example demonstrates how an Entity can be used as a Base Class for multiple Child Entities.

The Parent Class (`sent_parentclass.lua`) handles all of the logic for setting up the Entity's model and physics, as well as the logic behind the Entity's unique behavior. In this case, the unique behavior is that some arbitrary visual effect is enabled before the entity draws and is disabled after it draws. In the Parent Class, this visual effect simply turns the Entity blue.

Because the Child Classes (`sent_childclass_1.lua` and `sent_childclass_2.lua`) retain the logic of their Base Class (`sent_parentclass.lua`), they only need to include a very small amount of code to create different visual effects.

`sent_childclass_1.lua` overrides the function to enable the visual effect and replaces the Parent Class's blue color effect with a rainbow color effect.
`sent_childclass_2.lua` overrides both the enable and disable functions of the visual effect. They are replaced by functions that make the Entity (Which now looks like a tire) appear to always be rolling, even when stationary.
```lua
AddCSLuaFile()

-- All Entities must have a Base Class.
-- In this case, the "base_anim" Class is being used.
-- This is one of the default Entity Classes available in Garry's Mod.
DEFINE_BASECLASS( "base_anim" )

ENT.PrintName = "Parent Class"
ENT.Category = "BaseClass Example"
ENT.RenderGroup = RENDERGROUP_TRANSLUCENT
ENT.Spawnable = true

-- This variable exists to demonstrate that a Base Class provides both
-- functions and variables to their children.
-- This is a regular-width crate model.
ENT.ModelToSpawnWith = "models/props_junk/wood_crate001a_damaged.mdl"

-- Set up the Entity
function ENT:Initialize()
if SERVER then
self:SetModel( self.ModelToSpawnWith )
self:PhysicsInit( SOLID_VPHYSICS )
self:SetMoveType( MOVETYPE_VPHYSICS )
self:SetSolid( SOLID_VPHYSICS )
```

The following example demonstrates how an Entity can be used as a Base Class for multiple Child Entities.

The Parent Class (`sent_parentclass.lua`) handles all of the logic for setting up the Entity's model and physics, as well as the logic behind the Entity's unique behavior. In this case, the unique behavior is that some arbitrary visual effect is enabled before the entity draws and is disabled after it draws. In the Parent Class, this visual effect simply turns the Entity blue.

Because the Child Classes (`sent_childclass_1.lua` and `sent_childclass_2.lua`) retain the logic of their Base Class (`sent_parentclass.lua`), they only need to include a very small amount of code to create different visual effects.

`sent_childclass_1.lua` overrides the function to enable the visual effect and replaces the Parent Class's blue color effect with a rainbow color effect.
`sent_childclass_2.lua` overrides both the enable and disable functions of the visual effect. They are replaced by functions that make the Entity (Which now looks like a tire) appear to always be rolling, even when stationary.
